The sacrificer following behind, the wife following behind, taking the third of the footprint, having stepped out by the eastern door, having crept behind the axle of the southern havirdhāna cart, having dug up [the ground] with the wooden sword in the southern wheel-track, having sprinkled it, having laid down gold, and having strewn [grass] all around, he offers upon it with: 'Here Viṣṇu strode out; thrice he planted his foot; [all is] gathered in its dust. Svāhā!'

6.24.184.s: athaiteṣāṃ padapām̐sūnām ardhān patny añjalāv āvapati | athainān saṃsrāveṇābhighārayati
6.24.184.d: अथैतेषां पदपाँसूनाम् अर्धान् पत्न्य् अञ्जलाव् आवपति । अथैनान् संस्रावेणाभिघारयति
6.24.184.m: Then he pours half of these footprint-dust particles into the wife's folded hands. / Then he sprinkles them with the residue [of the ghee].

6.24.184.s: sā prācottānena pāṇinā dakṣiṇam akṣadhuram upānakti | ā no vīro jāyatāṃ karmaṇyo yam̐ sarve 'nujīvāma yo bahūnām asad vaśī | iti |
6.24.184.d: सा प्राचोत्तानेन पाणिना दक्षिणम् अक्षधुरम् उपानक्ति । आ नो वीरो जायतां कर्मण्यो यँ सर्वे ऽनुजीवाम यो बहूनाम् असद् वशी । इति ।
6.24.184.m: Facing east, with an upturned palm, she anoints the right axle-pin with [the formula]: 'May a hero be born to us, effective in action, on whom all of us may depend for life, who shall be the ruler of many.'

6.24.184.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvottarasya havirdhānasya paścād akṣam upasṛpyottarasyāṃ vartanyām̐ sphyenoddhatyāvokṣya hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya saṃparistīryābhijuhoti | irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtam̐ sūyavasinī manave yaśasye | vyaskabhnād rodasī viṣṇur ete dādhāra pṛthivīm abhito mayūkhaiḥ svāhā | iti |
6.24.184.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वोत्तरस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चाद् अक्षम् उपसृप्योत्तरस्यां वर्तन्याँ स्फ्येनोद्धत्यावोक्ष्य हिरण्यं निधाय संपरिस्तीर्याभिजुहोति । इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतँ सूयवसिनी मनवे यशस्ये । व्यस्कभ्नाद् रोदसी विष्णुर् एते दाधार पृथिवीम् अभितो मयूखैः स्वाहा । इति ।
6.24.184.m: Taking another four ladlings [of ghee], creeping behind the axle of the northern havirdhāna car, having dug up [the ground] on the northern wheel-track with the wooden sword, sprinkled it, placed a piece of gold [there], and strewn [barhis] around it, he offers upon it with: 'Rich in food, rich in cattle, rich in good pasture, glorious for Manu may you two be! Viṣṇu propped apart these two world-halves; he held the earth firm all around with pegs, svāhā!'

6.24.185.s: atraitān padapām̐sūn sarvaśa eva patny añjalāv āvapati |
6.24.185.d: अत्रैतान् पदपाँसून् सर्वश एव पत्न्य् अञ्जलाव् आवपति ।
6.24.185.m: Here he pours all the rest of these footprint-dust particles into the wife's folded hands.

6.24.185.s: athainān sam̐srāveṇābhighārayati sā prācottānenaiva pāṇinottaram akṣadhuram upānakti
6.24.185.d: अथैनान् सँस्रावेणाभिघारयति सा प्राचोत्तानेनैव पाणिनोत्तरम् अक्षधुरम् उपानक्ति
6.24.185.m: Then he sprinkles them with the residue [of the ghee]. Facing east, with an upturned palm, she anoints the northern axle-pin.

6.24.185.s: samāna upāñjanas | athaitāni śastrāṇi pratiprasthātra utprayacchati
6.24.185.d: समान उपाञ्जनस् । अथैतानि शस्त्राणि प्रतिप्रस्थात्र उत्प्रयच्छति
6.24.185.m: The formula for anointing is the same. Then he hands over these implements to the pratiprasthātṛ priest.

6.24.185.s: nayanti patnīm̐ hvayanti hotāram athaine saṃparigṛhya saṃpraiṣam āha ||
6.24.185.d: नयन्ति पत्नीँ ह्वयन्ति होतारम् अथैने संपरिगृह्य संप्रैषम् आह ॥
6.24.185.m: They lead the wife [away]; they summon the hotṛ priest. Then, taking hold of the two [havirdhāna cars], he utters the direction:

6.25.185.s: havirdhānābhyāṃ pravartyamānābhyām anubrūhi | iti triruktāyāṃ pravartayanti prācī pretam adhvaraṃ kalpayantī ūrdhvaṃ yajñaṃ nayataṃ mā jīhvaratam iti |
6.25.185.d: हविर्धानाभ्यां प्रवर्त्यमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि । इति त्रिरुक्तायां प्रवर्तयन्ति प्राची प्रेतम् अध्वरं कल्पयन्ती ऊर्ध्वं यज्ञं नयतं मा जीह्वरतम् इति ।
6.25.185.m: 'Recite for the two havirdhāna cars being moved forward!' When it has been recited three times, they move them forward with: 'Go forward, facing east, arranging the sacrifice! Carry the sacrifice upward; do not falter!'

6.25.185.s: atha yady akṣa utsarjati suvāg deva duryām̐ āvada | ity eva tatra japati |
6.25.185.d: अथ यद्य् अक्ष उत्सर्जति सुवाग् देव दुर्याँ आवद । इत्य् एव तत्र जपति ।
6.25.185.m: Then, if an axle screeches, he only mutters there: 'Speak well, O divine one, to the dwellings!'

6.25.185.s: athaitāv añjasopasaṃkrāmato 'dhvaryuś ca pratiprasthātā ca | uttareṇa havirdhāne parītya pūrvāvyupātītya madhyamād auttaravedikāc chaṅkor anuspandyaṃ trīn pratīcaḥ prakramān prakrāmatas
6.25.185.d: अथैताव् अञ्जसोपसंक्रामतो ऽध्वर्युश् च प्रतिप्रस्थाता च । उत्तरेण हविर्धाने परीत्य पूर्वाव्युपातीत्य मध्यमाद् औत्तरवेदिकाच् छङ्कोर् अनुस्पन्द्यं त्रीन् प्रतीचः प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रामतस्
6.25.185.m: Then the two, the adhvaryu priest and the pratiprasthātṛ priest, cross over directly. Having gone around the two havirdhāna cars on the north, having passed east of them, along the cord from the middle peg of the high altar, they stride three strides westward.

6.25.185.s: tad enayor nabhyasthayoś cubuke ramayatas | atra ramethāṃ varṣman pṛthivyās | iti |
6.25.185.d: तद् एनयोर् नभ्यस्थयोश् चुबुके रमयतस् । अत्र रमेथां वर्ष्मन् पृथिव्यास् । इति ।
6.25.185.m: There, while they stand on their naves, they bring their poles to rest with: 'Rest here on the highest peak of the earth!'

6.25.185.s: atha divo vā viṣṇav uta vā pṛthivyās | ity āśīr padayarcādhvaryur dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya dakṣiṇato methīṃ nihanti |
6.25.185.d: अथ दिवो वा विष्णव् उत वा पृथिव्यास् । इत्य् आशीर् पदयर्चाध्वर्युर् दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य दक्षिणतो मेथीं निहन्ति ।
6.25.185.m: Then with the verse containing the wish, 'Either from heaven, O Viṣṇu, or from the earth...', the adhvaryu priest drives a stake to the south of the southern havirdhāna car.

6.25.185.s: athainām̐ spandyayā sūpanibaddhām upanibadhnāti viṣṇor nukaṃ vīryāṇi pravocam iti |
6.25.185.d: अथैनाँ स्पन्द्यया सूपनिबद्धाम् उपनिबध्नाति विष्णोर् नुकं वीर्याणि प्रवोचम् इति ।
6.25.185.m: Then he ties it securely with a cord with: 'Now I will proclaim the heroic deeds of Viṣṇu.'

6.25.185.s: evam eva pratiprasthātottarasya havirdhānasyottarato methīṃ nihanti |
6.25.185.d: एवम् एव प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तरस्य हविर्धानस्योत्तरतो मेथीं निहन्ति ।
6.25.185.m: In the same way, the pratiprasthātṛ priest drives a stake to the north of the northern havirdhāna car.

6.25.186.s: athainām̐ spandyayā sūpanibaddhām upanibadhnāty etenaiva mantreṇa |
6.25.186.d: अथैनाँ स्पन्द्यया सूपनिबद्धाम् उपनिबध्नात्य् एतेनैव मन्त्रेण ।
6.25.186.m: Then he ties it securely with a cord with this very formula.

6.25.186.s: athādhvaryur dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya cubukāt prāñcam aratniṃ mītvā loke nyasya gartaṃ khānayati |
6.25.186.d: अथाध्वर्युर् दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य चुबुकात् प्राञ्चम् अरत्निं मीत्वा लोके न्यस्य गर्तं खानयति ।
6.25.186.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, having measured out an aratni eastward from the pole of the southern havirdhāna car, putting [a marker] in the place, has a pit dug.

6.25.186.s: atha dakṣiṇād yugāntāt prāñcaṃ bāhuṃ mītvā loke nyasya gartaṃ khānayati
6.25.186.d: अथ दक्षिणाद् युगान्तात् प्राञ्चं बाहुं मीत्वा लोके न्यस्य गर्तं खानयति
6.25.186.m: Then, having measured out an arm's length eastward from the south end of the yoke, putting [a marker] in the place, has a pit dug.

6.25.186.s: tāv ubhāv uttareṇānyaṃ gartaṃ khānayati | evam eva pratiprasthātottaratas trīn gartān khānayati |
6.25.186.d: ताव् उभाव् उत्तरेणान्यं गर्तं खानयति । एवम् एव प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तरतस् त्रीन् गर्तान् खानयति ।
6.25.186.m: To the north of both of them he has another pit dug. In the same way the pratiprasthātṛ priest has three pits dug on the north.

6.25.186.s: evam aparatas teṣu prācīnakarṇā sthūṇā ucchrayanti
6.25.186.d: एवम् अपरतस् तेषु प्राचीनकर्णा स्थूणा उच्छ्रयन्ति
6.25.186.m: In the same way on the west. In them they raise posts with ears facing east.

6.25.186.s: tāsūdañcau vam̐śau prohanti | adhyasyanti purastād rarāṭīṃ viṣṇo rarāṭam asi | iti
6.25.186.d: तासूदञ्चौ वँशौ प्रोहन्ति । अध्यस्यन्ति पुरस्ताद् रराटीं विष्णो रराटम् असि । इति
6.25.186.m: Upon them they lay two beams pointing north. In front they place the front-roof mat with: 'Thou art Viṣṇu's forehead.'

6.25.186.s: viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asi | iti madhyamaṃ chadiradhinidadhāti
6.25.186.d: विष्णोः पृष्ठम् असि । इति मध्यमं छदिरधिनिदधाति
6.25.186.m: With 'Thou art Viṣṇu's back', he places the middle roof-mat.

6.25.186.s: viṣṇo śnyaptre sthas | iti ye abhito bhavatas | dakṣiṇataś cottarataś ca pariśrayanti
6.25.186.d: विष्णो श्न्यप्त्रे स्थस् । इति ये अभितो भवतस् । दक्षिणतश् चोत्तरतश् च परिश्रयन्ति
6.25.186.m: With 'Ye two are Viṣṇu's mouth-corners', [he places] the two that are on both sides. They enclose [the shed] on the south and on the north.

6.25.186.s: prācīṃ ca pratīcīṃ ca dvārau kurvanti | atha dakṣiṇe dvārbāhau kuśahastam upanigṛhya darbhaṇaṃ pravayati darbhaṇe spandyām | viṣṇoḥ syūr asi | iti
6.25.186.d: प्राचीं च प्रतीचीं च द्वारौ कुर्वन्ति । अथ दक्षिणे द्वार्बाहौ कुशहस्तम् उपनिगृह्य दर्भणं प्रवयति दर्भणे स्पन्द्याम् । विष्णोः स्यूर् असि । इति
6.25.186.m: They make an eastern and a western door. Then, holding a handful of kuśa grass against the right door-post, he weaves through a needle, and through the needle a cord, with: 'Thou art Viṣṇu's suture.'

6.25.186.s: viṣṇor dhruvam asi | iti granthiṃ karoti
6.25.186.d: विष्णोर् ध्रुवम् असि । इति ग्रन्थिं करोति
6.25.186.m: With 'Thou art Viṣṇu's knot', he ties a knot.

6.25.186.s: taṃ tadānīm eva visrasyāha | akurvanto granthīn hastakauśalair nistiṣṭhata | iti | evam evottaraṃ dvārbāhum
6.25.186.d: तं तदानीम् एव विस्रस्याह । अकुर्वन्तो ग्रन्थीन् हस्तकौशलैर् निस्तिष्ठत । इति । एवम् एवोत्तरं द्वार्बाहुम्
6.25.186.m: Untying it at that very moment, he says: 'Without making knots, complete [the work] with manual skill!' In the same way [he treats] the northern door-post.

6.25.186.s: evam apare dvārbāhū nistiṣṭhati | athainad abhimṛśati vaiṣṇavam asi viṣṇave tvā | iti |
6.25.186.d: एवम् अपरे द्वार्बाहू निस्तिष्ठति । अथैनद् अभिमृशति वैष्णवम् असि विष्णवे त्वा । इति ।
6.25.186.m: In the same way he completes the two western door-posts. Then he touches it with: 'Thou belongest to Viṣṇu; for Viṣṇu thee!'

6.25.186.s: athādhvaryuḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya śālāmukhīyāc chaṅkor anuspandyam̐ ṣaṭ prācaḥ prakramān prakrāmati dakṣiṇā saptamam |
6.25.186.d: अथाध्वर्युः प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य शालामुखीयाच् छङ्कोर् अनुस्पन्द्यँ षट् प्राचः प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रामति दक्षिणा सप्तमम् ।
6.25.186.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, turning sunwise, running westward, along the cord from the peg of the śālāmukhīya fire, strides six paces eastward, and a seventh to the south.

6.25.187.s: tad abhriṃ nidadhāti sa audumbaryai kāle |
6.25.187.d: तद् अभ्रिं निदधाति स औदुम्बर्यै काले ।
6.25.187.m: There he places the spade. That is at the time for the audumbarī pillar.
At the time for the audumbarī pillar he takes up the spade,

6.26.187.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ādade | iti |
6.26.187.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् आददे । इति ।
6.26.187.m: with: 'At the impulse of divine Savitar, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take thee.'

6.26.187.s: ādāyābhimantrayate | abhrir asi nārir asi | iti tayaudumbaryā avaṭaṃ parilikhati parilikhitam̐ rakṣaḥ parilikhitā arātaya idam aham̐ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmi yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma idam asya grīvā apikṛntāmi | iti |
6.26.187.d: आदायाभिमन्त्रयते । अभ्रिर् असि नारिर् असि । इति तयौदुम्बर्या अवटं परिलिखति परिलिखितँ रक्षः परिलिखिता अरातय इदम् अहँ रक्षसो ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इदम् अस्य ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि । इति ।
6.26.187.m: Having taken it, he addresses it with: 'Thou art a spade; thou art a woman.' With it he draws around the pit for the audumbarī pillar with: 'Drawn around is the demon, drawn around are the enemies; here I cut off the neck of the demon; whoever hates us and whomsoever we hate, here I cut off his neck.'

6.26.187.s: athodgātāram āha | udgātar ehīmam audumbaryā avaṭaṃ khana prāk purīṣam udvapatāt | iti
6.26.187.d: अथोद्गातारम् आह । उद्गातर् एहीमम् औदुम्बर्या अवटं खन प्राक् पुरीषम् उद्वपतात् । इति
6.26.187.m: Then he says to the udgātṛ priest: 'Udgātṛ, come, dig this pit for the audumbarī pillar! Throw out the loose earth to the east!'

6.26.187.s: tam̐ sa khanati vā khānayati vā so 'ta eva sado vimimīte
6.26.187.d: तँ स खनति वा खानयति वा सो ऽत एव सदो विमिमीते
6.26.187.m: He digs it or causes it to be dug. From this very [spot] he measures out the sadas shed:

6.26.187.s: yathā trīṇi chadīm̐ṣi tiryañcy evaṃ prākśas | yathā trīṇi chadīm̐ṣy anvañcy evam udakśas |
6.26.187.d: यथा त्रीणि छदीँषि तिर्यञ्च्य् एवं प्राक्शस् । यथा त्रीणि छदीँष्य् अन्वञ्च्य् एवम् उदक्शस् ।
6.26.187.m: in such a way that there are three roof-mats crosswise, so eastward; in such a way that there are three roof-mats lengthwise, so northward.

6.26.187.s: api vā yathā dvau bhāgāv udak spandyāyai syātām eko dakṣiṇata iti
6.26.187.d: अपि वा यथा द्वौ भागाव् उदक् स्पन्द्यायै स्याताम् एको दक्षिणत इति
6.26.187.m: Or else, so that two parts are north of the cord, and one on the south.

6.26.187.s: tasya triśreṇigartān khānayati so 'ta eva prāṅ drutvā dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya puro 'kṣam uparavān vimimīte prādeśamukhān prādeśāntaspādān
6.26.187.d: तस्य त्रिश्रेणिगर्तान् खानयति सो ऽत एव प्राङ् द्रुत्वा दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पुरो ऽक्षम् उपरवान् विमिमीते प्रादेशमुखान् प्रादेशान्तस्पादान्
6.26.187.m: He has pits dug for it in three rows. Running eastward from that very [spot], in front of the axle of the southern havirdhāna car, he measures out the sound-holes, span-wide at the mouth and a span apart at their bases.

6.26.187.s: athonnetāram āha | unnetare hīmān uparavān khana prādeśamukhān prādeśāntaspādān bāhumātrān avāco 'saṃbhindann upariṣṭād adhastāt saṃtṛṇṇān iti
6.26.187.d: अथोन्नेतारम् आह । उन्नेतरे हीमान् उपरवान् खन प्रादेशमुखान् प्रादेशान्तस्पादान् बाहुमात्रान् अवाचो ऽसंभिन्दन्न् उपरिष्टाद् अधस्तात् संतृण्णान् इति
6.26.187.m: Then he says to the unnetṛ priest: 'Unnetṛ, come, dig these sound-holes, span-wide at the mouth, a span apart at their bases, an arm's length deep, downwards, without breaking through each other above, but perforated together below!'

6.26.188.s: tān sa khanati vā khānayati vā | athaiṣāṃ purīṣaṃ dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyāgreṇopastambhanaṃ nivapati
6.26.188.d: तान् स खनति वा खानयति वा । अथैषां पुरीषं दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्याग्रेणोपस्तम्भनं निवपति
6.26.188.m: He digs them or causes them to be dug. Then he heaps up their loose earth in front of the prop of the southern havirdhāna car.
He makes it into a square mound.

6.26.188.s: athainam̐ sikatābhir ābhrāśinaṃ karoti | athoparavāṇāṃ kālād abhrim ādatte devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ādade | iti |
6.26.188.d: अथैनँ सिकताभिर् आभ्राशिनं करोति । अथोपरवाणां कालाद् अभ्रिम् आदत्ते देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् आददे । इति ।
6.26.188.m: Then he makes it smooth with sand. Then, at the time of the sound-holes, he takes the spade with: 'At the impulse of divine Savitar, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take thee.'

6.26.188.s: ādāyābhimantrayate | abhrir asi nārir asi | iti
6.26.188.d: आदायाभिमन्त्रयते । अभ्रिर् असि नारिर् असि । इति
6.26.188.m: Having taken it, he addresses it with: 'Thou art a spade; thou art a woman.'

6.26.188.s: tayā yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati yathāntarvedyardham̐ syād bahirvedyardham | parilikhitam̐ rakṣaḥ parilikhitā arātaya idam aham̐ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmi yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma idam asya grīvā apikṛntāmi | iti |
6.26.188.d: तया यूपावटं परिलिखति यथान्तर्वेद्यर्धँ स्याद् बहिर्वेद्यर्धम् । परिलिखितँ रक्षः परिलिखिता अरातय इदम् अहँ रक्षसो ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इदम् अस्य ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि । इति ।
6.26.188.m: With it he draws around the pit for the sacrificial post, so that half is within the altar and half outside the altar, with: 'Drawn around is the demon, drawn around are the enemies; here I cut off the neck of the demon; whoever hates us and whomsoever we hate, here I cut off his neck.'

6.26.188.s: athāgnīdhram āha | agnīd ehi | imaṃ yūpāvaṭaṃ khana | uparasaṃmitaṃ prāk purīṣam udvapatāt | caturaṅgulenoparam atikhanatāt | iti
6.26.188.d: अथाग्नीध्रम् आह । अग्नीद् एहि । इमं यूपावटं खन । उपरसंमितं प्राक् पुरीषम् उद्वपतात् । चतुरङ्गुलेनोपरम् अतिखनतात् । इति
6.26.188.m: Then he says to the āgnīdhra priest: 'Āgnīdhra, come! Dig this pit for the sacrificial post! Throw out the loose earth to the east, measured up to the lower butt! Dig deeper than the lower butt by four finger-breadths!'

6.26.188.s: tam̐ sa khanati vā khānayati vā
6.26.188.d: तँ स खनति वा खानयति वा
6.26.188.m: He digs it or causes it to be dug.

6.26.188.s: yāvad evātrādhvaryuś ceṣṭati tāvad eṣa pratiprasthātaudumbarīm̐ sthūṇāṃ yajamānena saṃmāyādhastāt parivāsayati | acchinno rāyaḥ suvīras | iti |
6.26.188.d: यावद् एवात्राध्वर्युश् चेष्टति तावद् एष प्रतिप्रस्थातौदुम्बरीँ स्थूणां यजमानेन संमायाधस्तात् परिवासयति । अच्छिन्नो रायः सुवीरस् । इति ।
6.26.188.m: Just while the adhvaryu priest is busy here, the pratiprasthātṛ priest measures the audumbarī pillar with the sacrificer and cuts off [its bark or bottom] from below with: 'Unbroken wealth with good heroes!'

6.26.188.s: athādhvaryuḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya yācati yavamatīḥ prokṣaṇīr barhirhastam ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvāṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍam̐ hiraṇyam udapātram iti |
6.26.188.d: अथाध्वर्युः प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य याचति यवमतीः प्रोक्षणीर् बर्हिर्हस्तम् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवां मैत्रावरुणदण्डँ हिरण्यम् उदपात्रम् इति ।
6.26.188.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, turning sunwise and running westwards, asks for: sprinkling waters containing barley, a grass handful, a pot of clarified butter with a dipping spoon, a staff of the Maitrāvaruṇa priest, gold, and a water-pot.

6.26.188.s: audumbary eṣā sthūṇā prakṣālitā prapannā prāgavaṭād upaśete tāṃ parastād arvācīṃ prokṣati ||
6.26.188.d: औदुम्बर्य् एषा स्थूणा प्रक्षालिता प्रपन्ना प्रागवटाद् उपशेते तां परस्ताद् अर्वाचीं प्रोक्षति ॥
6.26.188.m: This audumbarī pillar, washed and brought in, lies east of the hole. He sprinkles it from the top towards the base,

6.27.188.s: dive tvāntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā | iti | avaṭe 'po 'vanayati śundhatāṃ lokaḥ pitṛṣadanas | iti
6.27.188.d: दिवे त्वान्तरिक्षाय त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वा । इति । अवटे ऽपो ऽवनयति शुन्धतां लोकः पितृषदनस् । इति
6.27.188.m: with: 'To heaven you! To the atmosphere you! To the earth you!' He pours water into the hole with: 'Let the realm, the seat of the fathers, be cleansed!'

6.27.188.s: yavān praskandayati yavo 'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātīs | iti
6.27.188.d: यवान् प्रस्कन्दयति यवो ऽसि यवयास्मद् द्वेषो यवयारातीस् । इति
6.27.188.m: He scatters barley grains with: 'You are barley; keep away our hatred, keep away our enemies!'

6.27.188.s: barhirhastaṃ vyatiṣajyāvastṛṇāti pitṛṇām̐ sadanam asi | iti |
6.27.188.d: बर्हिर्हस्तं व्यतिषज्यावस्तृणाति पितृणाँ सदनम् असि । इति ।
6.27.188.m: Intertwining a handful of barhis grass, he spreads it at the bottom with: 'You are the seat of the fathers!'

6.27.189.s: athainad dhiraṇyam antardhāya sruvāhutyābhijuhoti pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā | iti |
6.27.189.d: अथैनद् धिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय स्रुवाहुत्याभिजुहोति पितृभ्यः स्वाहा । इति ।
6.27.189.m: Then, putting this gold between, he makes an oblation with the ladle libation with: 'To the fathers, svāhā!'

6.27.189.s: athainām ucchrayati | ud divam̐ stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa pṛthivīṃ dṛm̐ha | iti |
6.27.189.d: अथैनाम् उच्छ्रयति । उद् दिवँ स्तभानान्तरिक्षं पृण पृथिवीं दृँह । इति ।
6.27.189.m: Then he erects it with: 'Prop up the sky, fill the atmosphere, make firm the earth!'

6.27.189.s: athaināṃ prācīnakarṇāṃ minoti dyutānas tvā māruto minotu mitrāvaruṇayordhruveṇa dharmaṇā | iti |
6.27.189.d: अथैनां प्राचीनकर्णां मिनोति द्युतानस् त्वा मारुतो मिनोतु मित्रावरुणयोर्ध्रुवेण धर्मणा । इति ।
6.27.189.m: Then he sets it up, its fork facing east, with: 'May Dyutāna the Marut set you up with the firm law of Mitra and Varuṇa!'

6.27.189.s: athainā pradakṣiṇaṃ purīṣeṇa paryūhati brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravanim̐ suprajāvanim̐ rāyaspoṣavaniṃ paryūhāmi | iti
6.27.189.d: अथैना प्रदक्षिणं पुरीषेण पर्यूहति ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा क्षत्रवनिँ सुप्रजावनिँ रायस्पोषवनिं पर्यूहामि । इति
6.27.189.m: Then he banks it around sunwise with earth, with: 'Winning the priesthood, winning the nobility, winning good offspring, winning the increase of wealth, I bank you around!'

6.27.189.s: maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍena sam̐hanti brahma dṛm̐ha kṣatram̐ dṛm̐ha prajāṃ dṛm̐ha āyas poṣaṃ dṛm̐ha | iti |
6.27.189.d: मैत्रावरुणदण्डेन सँहन्ति ब्रह्म दृँह क्षत्रँ दृँह प्रजां दृँह आयस् पोषं दृँह । इति ।
6.27.189.m: He rams it down with the staff of the Maitrāvaruṇa with: 'Make firm the priesthood! Make firm the nobility! Make firm the offspring! Make firm the increase of wealth!'
Having piled [the earth] evenly around, neither less nor more, and having poured down the water-pot,

6.27.189.s: athāsyai viśākhe hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya sruvāhutyābhijuhoti ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇethām̐ svāhā | iti |
6.27.189.d: अथास्यै विशाखे हिरण्यं निधाय स्रुवाहुत्याभिजुहोति घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आपृणेथाँ स्वाहा । इति ।
6.27.189.m: then placing gold in its fork, he makes an oblation with the ladle libation with: 'Fill heaven and earth with ghee, svāhā!'
He lets it trickle down right to the bottom.

6.27.189.s: āntam eva yajamānaṃ tejasānakti | iti brāhmaṇam athainām udgātṛbhyaḥ prāhus
6.27.189.d: आन्तम् एव यजमानं तेजसानक्ति । इति ब्राह्मणम् अथैनाम् उद्गातृभ्यः प्राहुस्
6.27.189.m: 'Right to the end he anoints the sacrificer with fiery energy,' says the brāhmaṇa passage. Then they announce it to the udgātṛ priests.

6.27.189.s: tasyāṃ tac ceṣṭanti yat te vidus | etasyā ucchrayaṇam anu prācīnakarṇā stūṇā ucchrayanti
6.27.189.d: तस्यां तच् चेष्टन्ति यत् ते विदुस् । एतस्या उच्छ्रयणम् अनु प्राचीनकर्णा स्तूणा उच्छ्रयन्ति
6.27.189.m: They perform at it what they know. Following its erection, they erect the [other] pillars with forks facing east.

6.27.189.s: tāsūdīco vam̐śān prohanti | adhyasyanti madhyamaṃ chadis | indrasya sado 'si | iti
6.27.189.d: तासूदीचो वँशान् प्रोहन्ति । अध्यस्यन्ति मध्यमं छदिस् । इन्द्रस्य सदो ऽसि । इति
6.27.189.m: Across them they lay beams facing north. They place the middle roof-mat on top with: 'You are Indra's sadas shed!'

6.27.189.s: viśvajanasya chāyā | iti ye abhito bhavatas |
6.27.189.d: विश्वजनस्य छाया । इति ये अभितो भवतस् ।
6.27.189.m: With: 'The shade of all people!' [they place] those that are on both sides.
'He should set up a nine-roofed [sadas shed] for one desiring fiery energy,' [the brāhmaṇa says].

6.27.189.s: trīṇitrīṇy eva sarvāṇi bhavanti dakṣiṇāny uttarāṇi karoti
6.27.189.d: त्रीणित्रीण्य् एव सर्वाणि भवन्ति दक्षिणान्य् उत्तराणि करोति
6.27.189.m: All [the rows of roof-mats] consist of three each. 'He puts the southern ones on top of the northern ones.'

6.27.189.s: sa dakṣiṇānidakṣiṇāny evottarāṇi karoti | antarvartān karoti vyāvṛttyai | iti
6.27.189.d: स दक्षिणानिदक्षिणान्य् एवोत्तराणि करोति । अन्तर्वर्तान् करोति व्यावृत्त्यै । इति
6.27.189.m: He places each southern one over the northern one. 'He makes inside-folds for distinction,' [the brāhmaṇa says].
He pushes grass-pads into the joints. Those are the inside-folds.

6.27.189.s: athainat pariśrayanti pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvato vṛddhāyum anu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayas | iti
6.27.189.d: अथैनत् परिश्रयन्ति परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतो वृद्धायुम् अनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयस् । इति
6.27.189.m: Then they enclose it with: 'O praise-worthy one, let these songs encompass you from all sides; increasing the lengthened life, let the pleasing ones be pleasing!'

6.27.190.m: They enclose it on the south and on the north.

6.27.190.s: prācīṃ ca pratīcīṃ ca dvārau kurvanti | atha dakṣiṇe dvārbāhau kuśahastam upanigṛhya darbhaṇaṃ pravayati darbhaṇe spandyām indrasya syūr asi | iti |
6.27.190.d: प्राचीं च प्रतीचीं च द्वारौ कुर्वन्ति । अथ दक्षिणे द्वार्बाहौ कुशहस्तम् उपनिगृह्य दर्भणं प्रवयति दर्भणे स्पन्द्याम् इन्द्रस्य स्यूर् असि । इति ।
6.27.190.m: They make an eastern and a western door. Then, fastening a handful of kuśa grass against the southern door-post, he weaves a needle of darbha grass and, with the needle, a cord, with: 'You are Indra's seam!'

6.27.190.s: indrasya dhruvam asi | iti granthiṃ karoti taṃ tadānīm eva visrasyāha | akurvanto granthīn hastakauśalair nistiṣṭhata | iti |
6.27.190.d: इन्द्रस्य ध्रुवम् असि । इति ग्रन्थिं करोति तं तदानीम् एव विस्रस्याह । अकुर्वन्तो ग्रन्थीन् हस्तकौशलैर् निस्तिष्ठत । इति ।
6.27.190.m: He makes a knot with: 'You are Indra's firmness!' Having immediately loosened it, he says: 'Without making knots, complete [it] with manual skill!'
In the same way, the northern door-post.

6.27.190.s: evam apare dvārbāhū nistiṣṭhati | athainad abhimṛśati | aindram asi | indrāya tvā | iti |
6.27.190.d: एवम् अपरे द्वार्बाहू निस्तिष्ठति । अथैनद् अभिमृशति । ऐन्द्रम् असि । इन्द्राय त्वा । इति ।
6.27.190.m: In the same way, he completes the two western door-posts. Then he touches it with: 'Belonging to Indra you are!' 'To Indra you!'

6.27.190.s: atha mahāvedyā uttarād am̐sīyāc chaṅkor vedyante nāṣṭādaśa pratīcaḥ prakramān prakrāmati
6.27.190.d: अथ महावेद्या उत्तराद् अँसीयाच् छङ्कोर् वेद्यन्ते नाष्टादश प्रतीचः प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रामति
6.27.190.m: Then, from the northern shoulder-peg of the great altar, he takes eighteen steps westward along the edge of the altar.

6.27.190.s: tad āgnīdhrāgāraṃ vimimīte yathāntarvedyardham̐ syād bahirvedyardham
6.27.190.d: तद् आग्नीध्रागारं विमिमीते यथान्तर्वेद्यर्धँ स्याद् बहिर्वेद्यर्धम्
6.27.190.m: There he measures out the āgnīdhra shed so that half may be inside the altar and half outside the altar.
Then, raising it up, they enclose it.

6.27.190.s: tasya dakṣiṇāṃ dvāraṃ kurvanti | āgnīdhrāgārasya pārśvamānī pañcāratnis |
6.27.190.d: तस्य दक्षिणां द्वारं कुर्वन्ति । आग्नीध्रागारस्य पार्श्वमानी पञ्चारत्निस् ।
6.27.190.m: They make its door on the south. The side measure of the āgnīdhra shed is five cubits.

6.27.190.s: etena mārjālīyo vyākhyātas tasyodīcīṃ dvāraṃ kurvanti ||
6.27.190.d: एतेन मार्जालीयो व्याख्यातस् तस्योदीचीं द्वारं कुर्वन्ति ॥
6.27.190.m: By this the mārjālīya shed is explained. They make its door on the north.

6.28.190.s: athātraiva tiṣṭhan yācaty abhriṃ yavamatīḥ prokṣaṇīr barhirhastam ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām adhiṣavaṇaṃ carmādhiṣavaṇe phalake ṣaṭ chaṅkūn grāvāṇam̐ hiraṇyam udapātram iti |
6.28.190.d: अथात्रैव तिष्ठन् याचत्य् अभ्रिं यवमतीः प्रोक्षणीर् बर्हिर्हस्तम् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाम् अधिषवणं चर्माधिषवणे फलके षट् छङ्कून् ग्रावाणँ हिरण्यम् उदपात्रम् इति ।
6.28.190.m: Then standing right there, he calls for: the spade, the sprinkling waters containing barley, a handful of barhis grass, a pot of clarified butter with a dipping spoon, the pressing skin, the two pressing boards, six pegs, the pressing stone, gold, and a water-pot.

6.28.190.s: etat samādāyāha | ehi yajamāna | iti pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādya dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya nīḍa etac carmotsādayati
6.28.190.d: एतत् समादायाह । एहि यजमान । इति पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपाद्य दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य नीड एतच् चर्मोत्सादयति
6.28.190.m: Taking these, he says: 'Come, sacrificer!' Bringing them into the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door, he sets this skin down in the body of the southern havirdhāna cart.

6.28.190.s: puro 'kṣam itarāṇi sam̐sādayanti | athoparavāṇāṃ kālād abhrim ādatte devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ādade | i iti |
6.28.190.d: पुरो ऽक्षम् इतराणि सँसादयन्ति । अथोपरवाणां कालाद् अभ्रिम् आदत्ते देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् आददे । इ इति ।
6.28.190.m: They place the others in front of the axle. Then at the time for the sounding-holes, he takes the spade with: 'At the impulse of the god Savitar, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take you!'

6.28.190.s: ādāyābhimantrayate | abhrir asi nārir asi | iti tayoparavān parilikhati pūrvayor dakṣiṇam evāgre parilikhitam̐ rakṣaḥ parilikhitā arātaya idam aham̐ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmi yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma idam asya grīvā apikṛntāmi | iti sarvān evānupūrvam |
6.28.190.d: आदायाभिमन्त्रयते । अभ्रिर् असि नारिर् असि । इति तयोपरवान् परिलिखति पूर्वयोर् दक्षिणम् एवाग्रे परिलिखितँ रक्षः परिलिखिता अरातय इदम् अहँ रक्षसो ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्म इदम् अस्य ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि । इति सर्वान् एवानुपूर्वम् ।
6.28.190.m: Having taken it, he addresses it with: 'A spade you are!' 'A woman you are!' With it he outlines the sounding-holes, the southern of the eastern two first, with: 'Outlined is the demon, outlined are the enemies; here I cut off the neck of the demon!' 'He who hates us and whom we hate, here I cut off his neck!'—all of them in succession.

6.28.191.s: khanati rakṣohaṇo valagahano vaiṣṇavān khanāmi | iti sarvān evānupūrvam
6.28.191.d: खनति रक्षोहणो वलगहनो वैष्णवान् खनामि । इति सर्वान् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.191.m: He digs with: 'Slaying the demons, slaying spells, belonging to Viṣṇu I dig!'—all of them in succession.

6.28.191.s: athaibhyaḥ pām̐sūn udvapati | idam ahaṃ taṃ valagam udvapāmi yaṃ naḥ samāno yam asamāno nicakhāna | idam enam adharaṃ karomi yo naḥ samāno yo 'samāno 'rātīyati gāyatreṇa chandasā | iti |
6.28.191.d: अथैभ्यः पाँसून् उद्वपति । इदम् अहं तं वलगम् उद्वपामि यं नः समानो यम् असमानो निचखान । इदम् एनम् अधरं करोमि यो नः समानो यो ऽसमानो ऽरातीयति गायत्रेण छन्दसा । इति ।
6.28.191.m: Then he throws out earth from them with: 'Here I cast out that spell which equal or unequal has buried for us!' 'Here I humble him who, equal or unequal, is hostile to us!' 'With the gāyatrī metre!'

6.28.191.s: avabāḍho valagas | iti yajamānasyādhaspadaṃ pām̐sūn udvapati pūrvayor dakṣiṇāt
6.28.191.d: अवबाढो वलगस् । इति यजमानस्याधस्पदं पाँसून् उद्वपति पूर्वयोर् दक्षिणात्
6.28.191.m: With: 'Downcast is the spell!' he casts out earth from under the feet of the sacrificer, from the southern of the eastern two;
with: 'With the triṣṭubh metre!' from the southern of the western two;
with: 'With the jagatī metre!' from the northern of the western two;

6.28.191.s: ānuṣṭubhena chandasā | iti pūrvayor uttarāt | atraitān padapām̐sūn asañcare parāvapati |
6.28.191.d: आनुष्टुभेन छन्दसा । इति पूर्वयोर् उत्तरात् । अत्रैतान् पदपाँसून् असञ्चरे परावपति ।
6.28.191.m: with: 'With the anuṣṭubh metre!' from the northern of the eastern two. Then he casts away these footprint-dusts in an unfrequented place.

6.28.191.s: atra yaṃ yajamāno dveṣṭi taṃ manasā dhyāyati | athāpa upaspṛśyāthainān avamṛśato 'dhvaryuś ca yajamānaś ca pūrvayor dakṣiṇam evādhvaryur avamṛśaty uttaraṃ yajamānas |
6.28.191.d: अत्र यं यजमानो द्वेष्टि तं मनसा ध्यायति । अथाप उपस्पृश्याथैनान् अवमृशतो ऽध्वर्युश् च यजमानश् च पूर्वयोर् दक्षिणम् एवाध्वर्युर् अवमृशत्य् उत्तरं यजमानस् ।
6.28.191.m: Here, whomever the sacrificer hates, he thinks of him in his mind. Then having touched water, both the adhvaryu priest and the sacrificer grope into them: the adhvaryu priest gropes into the southern of the eastern two, and the sacrificer into the northern.

6.28.191.s: atha yajamānaḥ pṛcchati adhvaryo kim atra | iti
6.28.191.d: अथ यजमानः पृच्छति अध्वर्यो किम् अत्र । इति
6.28.191.m: Then the sacrificer asks: 'Adhvaryu, what is here?'

6.28.191.s: bhadram iti tan nau saha | iti | athādhvaryuḥ pṛcchati yajamāna kim atra | iti
6.28.191.d: भद्रम् इति तन् नौ सह । इति । अथाध्वर्युः पृच्छति यजमान किम् अत्र । इति
6.28.191.m: 'Auspiciousness,' [he replies]. 'Let that be shared by both of us!' Then the adhvaryu priest asks: 'Sacrificer, what is here?'

6.28.191.s: bhadram iti tan nau saha | iti yam evādhvaryuḥ prajahāti taṃ yajamāno 'vamṛśati
6.28.191.d: भद्रम् इति तन् नौ सह । इति यम् एवाध्वर्युः प्रजहाति तं यजमानो ऽवमृशति
6.28.191.m: 'Auspiciousness,' [he replies]. 'Let that be shared by both of us!' Whichever the adhvaryu priest leaves, that the sacrificer gropes into.

6.28.191.s: dakṣiṇayor aparam evādhvaryur avamṛśati pūrvaṃ yajamānas |
6.28.191.d: दक्षिणयोर् अपरम् एवाध्वर्युर् अवमृशति पूर्वं यजमानस् ।
6.28.191.m: Of the two southern ones, the adhvaryu priest gropes into the western one and the sacrificer into the eastern.

6.28.191.s: adhvaryur atra pṛcchati | atha yajamānas | aparayor uttaram evādhvaryur avamṛśati dakṣiṇaṃ yajamānas |
6.28.191.d: अध्वर्युर् अत्र पृच्छति । अथ यजमानस् । अपरयोर् उत्तरम् एवाध्वर्युर् अवमृशति दक्षिणं यजमानस् ।
6.28.191.m: Here the adhvaryu priest asks; then the sacrificer. Of the two western ones, the adhvaryu priest gropes into the northern one and the sacrificer into the southern.

6.28.191.s: yajamāno 'tra pṛcchati | athādhvaryus | uttarayoḥ pūrvam evādhvaryur avamṛśaty aparaṃ yajamānas |
6.28.191.d: यजमानो ऽत्र पृच्छति । अथाध्वर्युस् । उत्तरयोः पूर्वम् एवाध्वर्युर् अवमृशत्य् अपरं यजमानस् ।
6.28.191.m: The sacrificer asks here, then the adhvaryu priest. Of the two northern [holes], the adhvaryu priest touches the eastern one, the sacrificer the western one.
The adhvaryu priest asks here, then the sacrificer.

6.28.191.s: yajamānaḥ prathamaḥ pṛcchati yajamāna uttamas | athainān abhimṛśati virāḍ asi sapatnahā samrāḍ asi bhrātṛvyahā svarāḍ asy abhimātihā viśvārāḍ asi viśvāsāṃ nāṣṭrāṇām̐ hantā | iti sarvān evānupūrvam
6.28.191.d: यजमानः प्रथमः पृच्छति यजमान उत्तमस् । अथैनान् अभिमृशति विराड् असि सपत्नहा सम्राड् असि भ्रातृव्यहा स्वराड् अस्य् अभिमातिहा विश्वाराड् असि विश्वासां नाष्ट्राणाँ हन्ता । इति सर्वान् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.191.m: The sacrificer asks first; the sacrificer is the last. Then he touches them [with the words]: 'You are Virāj, slayer of rivals; you are Samrāj, slayer of enemies; you are Svarāj, slayer of the malicious; you are Viśvārāj, slayer of all destructive powers'—all of them in succession.

6.28.192.s: athainān adbhiḥ prokṣati rakṣohaṇo valagahanaḥ prokṣāmi vaiṣṇavān iti sarvān evānupūrvam
6.28.192.d: अथैनान् अद्भिः प्रोक्षति रक्षोहणो वलगहनः प्रोक्षामि वैष्णवान् इति सर्वान् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.192.m: Then he sprinkles them with water [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I sprinkle you, belonging to Viṣṇu'—all of them in succession.

6.28.192.s: athaiṣv apo 'vanayati rakṣohaṇo valagahane 'vanayāmi vaiṣṇavān iti sarveṣv evānupūrvam
6.28.192.d: अथैष्व् अपो ऽवनयति रक्षोहणो वलगहने ऽवनयामि वैष्णवान् इति सर्वेष्व् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.192.m: Then he pours water into them [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I pour [water] into you, belonging to Viṣṇu'—into all of them in succession.

6.28.192.s: athaiṣu yavān praskandayati yavo 'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātīs | iti sarveṣv evānupūrvam
6.28.192.d: अथैषु यवान् प्रस्कन्दयति यवो ऽसि यवयास्मद् द्वेषो यवयारातीस् । इति सर्वेष्व् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.192.m: Then he scatters barley-grains into them [with the words]: 'You are barley; separate our hatred, separate our foes'—into all of them in succession.

6.28.192.s: athainān barhiṣāvastṛṇāti rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'vastṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavān iti sarvān evānupūrvam
6.28.192.d: अथैनान् बर्हिषावस्तृणाति रक्षोहणो वलगहनो ऽवस्तृणामि वैष्णवान् इति सर्वान् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.192.m: Then he strews sacrificial grass down into them [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I strew you down, belonging to Viṣṇu'—all of them in succession.

6.28.192.s: athainān hiraṇyam antardhāya sruvāhutyābhijuhoti rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'bhijuhomi vaiṣṇavān svāhā | iti sarvān evānupūrvam
6.28.192.d: अथैनान् हिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय स्रुवाहुत्याभिजुहोति रक्षोहणो वलगहनो ऽभिजुहोमि वैष्णवान् स्वाहा । इति सर्वान् एवानुपूर्वम्
6.28.192.m: Then, having placed a piece of gold in between, he offers upon them with a ladle libation [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I offer upon you, belonging to Viṣṇu, svāhā'—all of them in succession.

6.28.192.s: athāsyaite phalake dīrghasome saṃtṛṇṇe bhavato 'saṃtṛṇṇe ekāhe
6.28.192.d: अथास्यैते फलके दीर्घसोमे संतृण्णे भवतो ऽसंतृण्णे एकाहे
6.28.192.m: Now, these two pressing-boards of his are perforated in a long soma rite, unperforated in a one-day rite.

6.28.192.s: te sam̐spṛṣṭe upadadhāti rakṣohaṇau valagahanāv upadadhāmi vaiṣṇavī iti |
6.28.192.d: ते सँस्पृष्टे उपदधाति रक्षोहणौ वलगहनाव् उपदधामि वैष्णवी इति ।
6.28.192.m: He places them touching each other [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I place you two, belonging to Viṣṇu.'

6.28.192.s: athaine śaṅkubhiḥ pariṇihanti dvābhyāṃ purastād dvābhyāṃ paścād dvābhyām abhito 'navasarpaṇāya |
6.28.192.d: अथैने शङ्कुभिः परिणिहन्ति द्वाभ्यां पुरस्ताद् द्वाभ्यां पश्चाद् द्वाभ्याम् अभितो ऽनवसर्पणाय ।
6.28.192.m: Then he pegs them down with wooden pegs—with two on the east, two on the west, two on the sides, so that they do not slip away.

6.28.192.s: athaine pradakṣiṇaṃ purīṣeṇa paryūhati rakṣohaṇau valagahanau paryūhāmi vaiṣṇavī iti |
6.28.192.d: अथैने प्रदक्षिणं पुरीषेण पर्यूहति रक्षोहणौ वलगहनौ पर्यूहामि वैष्णवी इति ।
6.28.192.m: Then he banks them round with earth from left to right [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I bank you two round, belonging to Viṣṇu.'

6.28.192.s: athaine barhiṣā paristṛṇāti rakṣohaṇau valagahanau pariṣtṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavī iti |
6.28.192.d: अथैने बर्हिषा परिस्तृणाति रक्षोहणौ वलगहनौ परिष्तृणामि वैष्णवी इति ।
6.28.192.m: Then he strews sacrificial grass around them [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, I strew around you two, belonging to Viṣṇu.'

6.28.192.s: athaine abhimṛśati rakṣohaṇau valagahanau vaiṣṇavī iti |
6.28.192.d: अथैने अभिमृशति रक्षोहणौ वलगहनौ वैष्णवी इति ।
6.28.192.m: Then he touches them [with the words]: 'Destroyers of rakṣases, destroyers of charms, belonging to Viṣṇu.'

6.28.192.s: athaitac carma phalakayoḥ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomopastṛṇāti yajña pratitiṣṭha | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ vā
6.28.192.d: अथैतच् चर्म फलकयोः प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमोपस्तृणाति यज्ञ प्रतितिष्ठ । इति वा तूष्णीं वा
6.28.192.m: Then he spreads out this skin over the two pressing-boards, with its neck to the east and its hairy side upwards, with: 'O sacrifice, stand firm,' or silently.
Across the skin, he makes the two pressing-boards resound with a pressing-stone.

6.29.192.s: bṛhann asi bṛhadgrāvā bṛhatīm indrāya vācaṃ vada | iti nīḍa etac carmotsādayati
6.29.192.d: बृहन्न् असि बृहद्ग्रावा बृहतीम् इन्द्राय वाचं वद । इति नीड एतच् चर्मोत्सादयति
6.29.192.m: With: 'Great are you, a great pressing-stone; utter a great voice for Indra,' he removes this skin to the cart-box.

6.29.193.s: grāvasu grāvāṇam apyarjati | atha dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyāgreṇopastambhanaṃ barhirmuṣṭim upanibadhnāti stotrebhyas |
6.29.193.d: ग्रावसु ग्रावाणम् अप्यर्जति । अथ दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्याग्रेणोपस्तम्भनं बर्हिर्मुष्टिम् उपनिबध्नाति स्तोत्रेभ्यस् ।
6.29.193.m: He places a pressing-stone among the pressing-stones. Then, in front of the southern havirdhāna cart's prop, he ties a handful of sacrificial grass for the chants.

6.29.193.s: atha yācati sphyam udapātraṃ cātvālātpurīṣam̐ sikatā iti |
6.29.193.d: अथ याचति स्फ्यम् उदपात्रं चात्वालात्पुरीषँ सिकता इति ।
6.29.193.m: Then he calls for the wooden sword, the water-cup, earth from the pit, and sand.

6.29.193.s: āgnīdhraṃ drutvā sphyenoddhatyāvokṣya cātvālātpurīṣam̐ sikatā iti nivapati vibhūr asi pravāhaṇas | raudreṇānīkena pāhi māgne pipṛhi mā mā mā him̐sīs | iti
6.29.193.d: आग्नीध्रं द्रुत्वा स्फ्येनोद्धत्यावोक्ष्य चात्वालात्पुरीषँ सिकता इति निवपति विभूर् असि प्रवाहणस् । रौद्रेणानीकेन पाहि माग्ने पिपृहि मा मा मा हिँसीस् । इति
6.29.193.m: Running to the āgnīdhra shed, digging up [earth] with the wooden sword, sprinkling [it] with water, he throws out earth from the pit and sand, [with the words]: 'You are Vibhū, Pravāhaṇa. / Protect me, O Agni, with your Rudra-host; / preserve me; / do not harm me.'
He shapes it into a circular side-hearth.

6.29.193.s: athainam̐ sikatābhir ābhrāśinaṃ karoti | athāntaḥsadasaṃ dhiṣṇiyān nivapati hotuḥ prathamam | vahnir asi havyavāhanas | iti
6.29.193.d: अथैनँ सिकताभिर् आभ्राशिनं करोति । अथान्तःसदसं धिष्णियान् निवपति होतुः प्रथमम् । वह्निर् असि हव्यवाहनस् । इति
6.29.193.m: Then he covers it with sand so that it glistens. Then he throws out the side-hearths inside the sadas shed, first that of the hotṛ priest, [with]: 'You are Vahni, the bearer of oblations.'

6.29.193.s: śvātro 'si pracetās | iti dakṣiṇato maitrāvaruṇasya tutho 'si viśvavedās | ity uttarato brāhmaṇāccham̐sinas |
6.29.193.d: श्वात्रो ऽसि प्रचेतास् । इति दक्षिणतो मैत्रावरुणस्य तुथो ऽसि विश्ववेदास् । इत्य् उत्तरतो ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिनस् ।
6.29.193.m: [With]: 'You are Śvātra, the wise,' [he establishes the side-hearth] of the maitrāvaruṇa priest to the south; [with]: 'You are Tutha, the all-knowing,' that of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin priest to the north;

6.29.193.s: uśig asi kavis | ity uttarataḥ potus |
6.29.193.d: उशिग् असि कविस् । इत्य् उत्तरतः पोतुस् ।
6.29.193.m: [with]: 'You are Uśig, the poet,' that of the potṛ priest to the north;

6.29.193.s: aṅghārir asi bambhāris | ity uttarato neṣṭus | avasyur asi duvasvān ity uttarato 'cchāvākasya |
6.29.193.d: अङ्घारिर् असि बम्भारिस् । इत्य् उत्तरतो नेष्टुस् । अवस्युर् असि दुवस्वान् इत्य् उत्तरतो ऽच्छावाकस्य ।
6.29.193.m: [with]: 'You are Aṅghāri, Bambhāri,' that of the neṣṭṛ priest to the north; [with]: 'You are Avasyu, Duvasvān,' that of the acchāvāka priest to the north.

6.29.193.s: atha dakṣiṇe vedyante mārjālīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ nivapati śundhyūr asi mārjālīyas | iti
6.29.193.d: अथ दक्षिणे वेद्यन्ते मार्जालीयं धिष्णियं निवपति शुन्ध्यूर् असि मार्जालीयस् । इति
6.29.193.m: Then, at the southern border of the altar, he throws out the mārjālīya side-hearth [with]: 'You are Śundhyu, the cleanser.'
Over all [of them] he follows up with the Rudra-formula.

6.29.193.s: āgnīdhre 'ntato nivapaty udaksam̐sthatāyā iti | aṣṭau nyavāpsīd iti |
6.29.193.d: आग्नीध्रे ऽन्ततो निवपत्य् उदक्सँस्थताया इति । अष्टौ न्यवाप्सीद् इति ।
6.29.193.m: In the āgnīdhra shed he throws out the last one, for the sake of ending in the north: thus he has thrown out eight.

6.29.193.s: athāṣṭāv anudiśati samrāḍ asi kṛśānus | ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate
6.29.193.d: अथाष्टाव् अनुदिशति सम्राड् असि कृशानुस् । इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते
6.29.193.m: Then he addresses eight [places]. He attends upon the āhavanīya fire with: 'You are Samrāj, Kṛśānu.'

6.29.193.s: pariṣadyo 'si pavamānas | ity āstāvam | pratakvāsi nabhasvān iti cātvālam
6.29.193.d: परिषद्यो ऽसि पवमानस् । इत्य् आस्तावम् । प्रतक्वासि नभस्वान् इति चात्वालम्
6.29.193.m: [He attends upon] the chanting-place with: 'You are Pariṣadya, Pavamāna'; the pit with: 'You are Pratakvan, Nabhasvān';

6.29.193.s: asaṃmṛṣṭo 'si havyasūdas | iti paśuśrapaṇam atha sadaso dvāri tiṣṭhann audumbarīm upatiṣṭhate | ṛtadhāmāsi suvarjyotis | iti
6.29.193.d: असंमृष्टो ऽसि हव्यसूदस् । इति पशुश्रपणम् अथ सदसो द्वारि तिष्ठन्न् औदुम्बरीम् उपतिष्ठते । ऋतधामासि सुवर्ज्योतिस् । इति
6.29.193.m: the animal-cooking fire with: 'You are unpolished, Havyasūd.' Then, standing at the door of the sadas shed, he attends upon the audumbarī pillar with: 'You are Ṛtadhāman, the light of heaven';

6.29.194.s: brahmajyotir asi suvardhāma | iti brahmasadanam athātraiva tiṣṭhan gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate | ajo 'sy ekapād iti |
6.29.194.d: ब्रह्मज्योतिर् असि सुवर्धाम । इति ब्रह्मसदनम् अथात्रैव तिष्ठन् गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते । अजो ऽस्य् एकपाद् इति ।
6.29.194.m: the seat of the brahman priest with: 'You are the light of the sacred word, the realm of heaven.' Then, standing right there, he attends upon the gārhapatya fire with: 'You are Aja Ekapād';

6.29.194.s: ahir asi budhniyas | iti yaṃ prahāsyanto bhavanti ||
6.29.194.d: अहिर् असि बुध्नियस् । इति यं प्रहास्यन्तो भवन्ति ॥
6.29.194.m: [and] upon the one which they are about to abandon with: 'You are Ahir Budhniya.'

6.30.194.s: athātraiva tiṣṭhan saṃpraiṣam āha stṛṇīta barhiḥ pra vrataṃ yacchata samapivratān hvayadhvam āstāvaṃ bahulam̐ stṛṇīta sadohavirdhāne bahule stṛṇītonnetar grāvṇo vāyavyāni droṇakalaśe daśapavitre samavadhāya patnīśāle sam̐sādayāgnīd ājyam adhiśraya pratiprasthātaḥ srucaḥ saṃmṛḍḍhy ājyenodehi pṛṣadājyāya dadhyāhara | iti
6.30.194.d: अथात्रैव तिष्ठन् संप्रैषम् आह स्तृणीत बर्हिः प्र व्रतं यच्छत समपिव्रतान् ह्वयध्वम् आस्तावं बहुलँ स्तृणीत सदोहविर्धाने बहुले स्तृणीतोन्नेतर् ग्राव्णो वायव्यानि द्रोणकलशे दशपवित्रे समवधाय पत्नीशाले सँसादयाग्नीद् आज्यम् अधिश्रय प्रतिप्रस्थातः स्रुचः संमृड्ढ्य् आज्येनोदेहि पृषदाज्याय दध्याहर । इति
6.30.194.m: Then, standing right there, he gives the order: 'Strew the sacrificial grass; distribute the fast-milk; summon those entitled to share the vow; strew the chanting-place thickly; strew the sadas shed and havirdhāna shed thickly; unnetṛ priest, place the pressing-stones and the vāyavya cups together into the wooden vat with the ten-fringed strainer, and set them down in the wife's hall; āgnīdhra priest, place the clarified butter over the fire; pratiprasthātṛ priest, wipe the ladles, come up with the clarified butter, bring curds for the speckled butter!'
They act according to the order.

6.30.194.s: atha dakṣiṇe vedyante barhirmuṣṭim̐ stṛṇāti devabarhis | ūrṇāmradasaṃ tvā stṛṇāmi svāsasthaṃ devebhyas | iti
6.30.194.d: अथ दक्षिणे वेद्यन्ते बर्हिर्मुष्टिँ स्तृणाति देवबर्हिस् । ऊर्णाम्रदसं त्वा स्तृणामि स्वासस्थं देवेभ्यस् । इति
6.30.194.m: Then, at the southern border of the altar, he strews a handful of sacrificial grass [with]: 'Divine grass, / soft as wool I strew you, a pleasant seat for the gods.'

6.30.194.s: tāṃ bahulāṃ purastāt pratyañca stṛṇanto yanti |
6.30.194.d: तां बहुलां पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्च स्तृणन्तो यन्ति ।
6.30.194.m: Strewing it thickly, they proceed from east to west.

6.30.194.s: athāntaḥśālaṃ pṛṣadājyavantyājyāni gṛhītvā parikarmibhya utpradāya brahmaṇe rājānam utprayacchati
6.30.194.d: अथान्तःशालं पृषदाज्यवन्त्याज्यानि गृहीत्वा परिकर्मिभ्य उत्प्रदाय ब्रह्मणे राजानम् उत्प्रयच्छति
6.30.194.m: Then, inside the hall, taking the clarified butters accompanied by the speckled butter and handing them over to the assistants, he presents the King [Soma] to the brahman priest.
Taking it, the brahman priest stands to the north.

6.30.194.s: uttaratas tiṣṭhann agnim anvānayati | ud agne tiṣṭhānu mānudehi viśvair devair yajñiyaiḥ saṃvidānaḥ | suvarge loke yajamānam̐ hi dhehi māsyai hāsthā āhutyai yām upemas | iti |
6.30.194.d: उत्तरतस् तिष्ठन्न् अग्निम् अन्वानयति । उद् अग्ने तिष्ठानु मानुदेहि विश्वैर् देवैर् यज्ञियैः संविदानः । सुवर्गे लोके यजमानँ हि धेहि मास्यै हास्था आहुत्यै याम् उपेमस् । इति ।
6.30.194.m: Standing to the north, [the adhvaryu priest] leads the fire along [with the words]: 'Arise, O Agni, follow after me, / in agreement with all the gods worthy of sacrifice. / Establish the sacrificer in the heavenly world; / do not miss this oblation which we approach.'
Then he puts on the kindling wood for the bringing forward.
They prepare the supportive [gravel pieces] from the pit.

6.30.194.s: samanvārabdheṣv apivrateṣu saṃpracchanneṣu gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā śālāmukhīye vaisarjanāni juhoti tvam̐ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo 'nyakṛtebhya uru yantāsi varūtham̐ svāhā | iti
6.30.194.d: समन्वारब्धेष्व् अपिव्रतेषु संप्रच्छन्नेषु गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा शालामुखीये वैसर्जनानि जुहोति त्वँ सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्यो ऽन्यकृतेभ्य उरु यन्तासि वरूथँ स्वाहा । इति
6.30.194.m: When those whose vows are completed have taken hold from behind and are completely veiled, having melted clarified butter on the gārhapatya [fire] and purified it, having taken four ladlings in the ladle, he offers the vaisarjana libations on the śālāmukhīya [fire] with: “You, O Soma, against bodily hatreds caused by others, are an ample giver of protection, svāhā!”

6.30.195.s: sruveṇāptuṃ praskandayati juṣāṇo aptur ājyasya vetu svāhā | iti |
6.30.195.d: स्रुवेणाप्तुं प्रस्कन्दयति जुषाणो अप्तुर् आज्यस्य वेतु स्वाहा । इति ।
6.30.195.m: With the dipping ladle he lets an aptu drop fall, with: “May the pleasing aptu enjoy the clarified butter, svāhā!”

6.30.195.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā saṃpraiṣam āha | agnīṣomābhyāṃ praṇīyamānābhyām anubrūhi | iti
6.30.195.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा संप्रैषम् आह । अग्नीषोमाभ्यां प्रणीयमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि । इति
6.30.195.m: Having taken another four ladlings, he gives the summons: “Recite [the verses] for Agni and Soma being brought forward!”

6.30.195.s: trir uktāyām udyacchante hotur vaśaṃ yanti | atha vai bhavati
6.30.195.d: त्रिर् उक्तायाम् उद्यच्छन्ते होतुर् वशं यन्ति । अथ वै भवति

6.30.195.s: prāñcam agniṃ praharanty ut patnīm ānayanty anv anām̐si pravartayanti | iti
6.30.195.d: प्राञ्चम् अग्निं प्रहरन्त्य् उत् पत्नीम् आनयन्त्य् अन्व् अनाँसि प्रवर्तयन्ति । इति
6.30.195.m: “They carry forward the fire eastward, they bring up the [sacrificer's] wife, they roll the carts along after it.”

6.30.195.s: yad asyātra śastraṃ bhavati pūrvaṃ tenāgnim anvavasyanti | athāgniprathamāḥ pratipadyante 'nvagrājñā cājyaiś cānvaggrāvṇo vāyavyāni
6.30.195.d: यद् अस्यात्र शस्त्रं भवति पूर्वं तेनाग्निम् अन्ववस्यन्ति । अथाग्निप्रथमाः प्रतिपद्यन्ते ऽन्वग्राज्ञा चाज्यैश् चान्वग्ग्राव्णो वायव्यानि
6.30.195.m:
Whatever recitation there is here, with that they first follow the fire.
Then, with the fire first, they proceed: behind [it] with the King [Soma] and the clarified butter, and behind [them] the press-stones and the vāyavya cups.

6.30.195.s: pūrvayā dvāropaniṣkrāmanti | ayaṃ no agnir varivaḥ kṛṇotv ayaṃ mṛdhaḥ pura etu prabhindan | ayaṃ śatrūñ jayatu jarhṛṣāṇo 'yaṃ vājaṃ jayatu vājasātau | iti |
6.30.195.d: पूर्वया द्वारोपनिष्क्रामन्ति । अयं नो अग्निर् वरिवः कृणोत्व् अयं मृधः पुर एतु प्रभिन्दन् । अयं शत्रूञ् जयतु जर्हृषाणो ऽयं वाजं जयतु वाजसातौ । इति ।
6.30.195.m: They go out by the eastern door, with: “May this Agni make broad room for us; may this one go before, shattering the foes; / may this one conquer the enemies, exulting; may this one conquer booty in the winning of booty.”

6.30.195.s: uttareṇa sadaḥ parītyāgnīdhāgāre 'gniṃ nidhāya nayavatyarcāgnīdhre juhoti | agne naya supathā rāye asmān viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhy asmaj juhurāṇam enas | bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema svāhā | iti |
6.30.195.d: उत्तरेण सदः परीत्याग्नीधागारे ऽग्निं निधाय नयवत्यर्चाग्नीध्रे जुहोति । अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्य् अस्मज् जुहुराणम् एनस् । भूयिष्ठां ते नमौक्तिं विधेम स्वाहा । इति ।
6.30.195.m: Having gone around south of the sadas, having placed the fire in the āgnīdhra shed, he offers on the āgnīdhra [fire] with a verse containing the word 'naya': “O Agni, lead us along a good path to wealth, / O god knowing all ways; / keep away from us crooked sin; / we offer you the highest utterance of homage, svāhā!”

6.30.195.s: atraivaitad grāvovāyavyam̐ samupasādyopātiyanti rājñā cājyaiś ca |
6.30.195.d: अत्रैवैतद् ग्रावोवायव्यँ समुपसाद्योपातियन्ति राज्ञा चाज्यैश् च ।
6.30.195.m: Right here having set down this press-stone and the vāyavya cup, they pass by with the King [Soma] and the clarified butter.

6.30.195.s: āhavanīye sruvāhutiṃ juhoti | uru viṣṇo vikramasvoru kṣayāya naḥ kṛdhi | ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā | iti ||
6.30.195.d: आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति । उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्वोरु क्षयाय नः कृधि । घृतं घृतयोने पिब प्रप्र यज्ञपतिं तिर स्वाहा । इति ॥
6.30.195.m: He offers a ladle libation on the āhavanīya fire, with: “Stride out widely, O Viṣṇu; make broad space for our dwelling; / drink the ghee, O you whose womb is ghee; extend further and further the lord of the sacrifice, svāhā!”

6.31.196.s: atha prokṣaṇībhir upottiṣṭhati | idhmaṃ prokṣati vediṃ prokṣati
6.31.196.d: अथ प्रोक्षणीभिर् उपोत्तिष्ठति । इध्मं प्रोक्षति वेदिं प्रोक्षति

6.31.196.s: barhiḥ prokṣati barhirāsannaṃ prokṣyopaninīya purastād āśvavālaṃ prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti
6.31.196.d: बर्हिः प्रोक्षति बर्हिरासन्नं प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्ताद् आश्ववालं प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति
6.31.196.m:
he sprinkles the sacrificial grass.
Having sprinkled the sacrificial grass that has been placed, having poured [the rest of the water] down, he takes the grass bundle made of horse-tail grass at the eastern end.

6.31.196.s: pañcavidhaṃ barhi stīrtvā prastarapāṇiḥ prāṅ abhisṛpya kārṣmaryamayān paridhīn paridadhāti |
6.31.196.d: पञ्चविधं बर्हि स्तीर्त्वा प्रस्तरपाणिः प्राङ् अभिसृप्य कार्ष्मर्यमयान् परिधीन् परिदधाति ।
6.31.196.m: Having spread the fivefold sacrificial grass, moving eastward with the grass bundle in hand, he places the enclosing sticks made of kārṣmarya wood around [the fire].

6.31.196.s: ūrdhve samidhāv ādadhāti | aikṣavī vidhṛtī tiraścī sādayati
6.31.196.d: ऊर्ध्वे समिधाव् आदधाति । ऐक्षवी विधृती तिरश्ची सादयति
6.31.196.m:
He places two upright kindling sticks.
He places two separators made of reed across.

Upon the two separators, the grass bundle made of horse-tail grass;
upon the grass bundle, the juhū ladle;

6.31.196.s: barhiṣītarās | etā asadan | iti samabhimṛśyāthāpa upaspṛśya brahmaṇo rājānam ādāya pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādayati somo jigāti gātuvid devānām eti niṣkṛtam ṛtasya yonim āsadam iti |
6.31.196.d: बर्हिषीतरास् । एता असदन् । इति समभिमृश्याथाप उपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मणो राजानम् आदाय पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपादयति सोमो जिगाति गातुविद् देवानाम् एति निष्कृतम् ऋतस्य योनिम् आसदम् इति ।
6.31.196.m:
upon the sacrificial grass, the other [ladles].
Having touched them together with: “These have sat down,” and then having touched water, having received the King [Soma] from the brahman priest, he makes him enter the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door, with: “Soma goes forward, finding the path; he goes to the meeting place of the gods, to sit upon the womb of truth.”

6.31.196.s: atha dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya nīḍe kṛṣṇājinam āstṛṇāti | adityāḥ sado 'si | iti |
6.31.196.d: अथ दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य नीडे कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तृणाति । अदित्याः सदो ऽसि । इति ।
6.31.196.m: Then he spreads a black antelope skin in the seat of the southern havirdhāna [cart], with: “You are the seat of Aditi.”

6.31.196.s: adityāḥ sada āsīda | iti kṛṣṇājine rājānam
6.31.196.d: अदित्याः सद आसीद । इति कृष्णाजिने राजानम्
6.31.196.m: [He places] the King [Soma] on the black antelope skin, with: “Sit down upon the seat of Aditi.”

6.31.196.s: athainaṃ devatābhyaḥ saṃprayacchati | eṣa vo deva savatitaḥ somas tam̐ rakṣadhvaṃ mā vo dabhat | iti
6.31.196.d: अथैनं देवताभ्यः संप्रयच्छति । एष वो देव सवतितः सोमस् तँ रक्षध्वं मा वो दभत् । इति
6.31.196.m: Then he hands him over to the deities, with: “O divine Savitar, this is your soma; protect him, let him not harm you.”

6.31.196.s: saṃpradāyopatiṣṭhate | etat tvam̐ soma devo devān upāgā idam ahaṃ manuṣyo manuṣyān saha prajayā saha rāyas poṣeṇa | iti
6.31.196.d: संप्रदायोपतिष्ठते । एतत् त्वँ सोम देवो देवान् उपागा इदम् अहं मनुष्यो मनुष्यान् सह प्रजया सह रायस् पोषेण । इति
6.31.196.m: Having handed him over, he reverences him, with: “As such, O Soma, you, a god, have approached the gods; here I, a mortal, [approach] mortals, together with offspring, together with abundance of wealth.”

6.31.196.s: namo devebhyas | iti prāñcam añjaliṃ karoti
6.31.196.d: नमो देवेभ्यस् । इति प्राञ्चम् अञ्जलिं करोति
6.31.196.m: He makes an añjali facing east, with: “Homage to the gods!”
He bends down towards the south, with: “Svadhā to the ancestors!”

6.31.196.s: athopaniṣkrāmati | idam ahaṃ nir varuṇasya pāśāt | iti | athāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate suvar abhivikhyeṣaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ jyotis | iti |
6.31.196.d: अथोपनिष्क्रामति । इदम् अहं निर् वरुणस्य पाशात् । इति । अथाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते सुवर् अभिविख्येषं वैश्वानरं ज्योतिस् । इति ।
6.31.196.m:
Then he goes out, with: “Here I [go] out of Varuṇa's noose.”
Then he reverences the āhavanīya fire, with: “May I look upon the light, the heaven, Vaiśvānara.”

6.31.196.s: atha yajamānam avāntaradīkṣāṃ visarjayati | agne vratapate tvaṃ vratānāṃ vratapatir asi yā mama tanūs tvayy abhūd iyam̐ sā mayi yā tava tanūr mayy abhūd eṣā sā tvyayi yathāyathaṃ nau vratapate vratinor vratāni | iti |
6.31.196.d: अथ यजमानम् अवान्तरदीक्षां विसर्जयति । अग्ने व्रतपते त्वं व्रतानां व्रतपतिर् असि या मम तनूस् त्वय्य् अभूद् इयँ सा मयि या तव तनूर् मय्य् अभूद् एषा सा त्व्ययि यथायथं नौ व्रतपते व्रतिनोर् व्रतानि । इति ।
6.31.196.m: Then he releases the sacrificer from the intermediate consecration, with: “O Agni, lord of vows, you are the lord of vows of vows; / whatever body of mine was in you, this it is in me; whatever body of yours was in me, this it is in you; / according to rule, O lord of vows, are the vows of us two vow-keepers.”

6.31.196.s: athainam̐ sam̐śāsti srasnīṣva mekhalāṃ pra muṣṭī sāraya maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayaccha yajamāna iti tvācakṣatāṃ nāmagrāhaṃ te pitṛbhiḥ pitāmahaiḥ prapitāmahaiḥ putraiḥ pautraiḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyām āhvayatu | iti
6.31.196.d: अथैनँ सँशास्ति स्रस्नीष्व मेखलां प्र मुष्टी सारय मैत्रावरुणाय दण्डं प्रयच्छ यजमान इति त्वाचक्षतां नामग्राहं ते पितृभिः पितामहैः प्रपितामहैः पुत्रैः पौत्रैः सुब्रह्मण्यः सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वयतु । इति
6.31.196.m: Then he instructs him: “Loosen your girdle, unbend your fists, give the staff to the maitrāvaruṇa priest; let them address you as ‘Sacrificer’; let the subrahmaṇya priest summon the subrahmaṇyā formula calling your name together with your fathers, grandfathers, great-grandfathers, sons, and grandsons.”

6.31.197.m: He does all this in just this way.

6.31.197.s: atha yūpāhutim̐ hutvā yūpaṃ yajuṣā karoti
6.31.197.d: अथ यूपाहुतिँ हुत्वा यूपं यजुषा करोति
6.31.197.m: Then, having offered the sacrificial-post libation, he prepares the sacrificial post with a yajus formula.

6.31.197.s: yūpāvaṭaṃ yajuṣā karoti tad etad yūpāvaṭāntam ||
6.31.197.d: यूपावटं यजुषा करोति तद् एतद् यूपावटान्तम् ॥
6.31.197.m:
He prepares the post-hole with a yajus formula.
This concludes with the post-hole.

6.32.197.s: atha yūpasyāvṛtā yūpam ucchrayati svarvantaṃ yūpam utsṛjyāgnīṣomīyaṃ paśum upākaroti
6.32.197.d: अथ यूपस्यावृता यूपम् उच्छ्रयति स्वर्वन्तं यूपम् उत्सृज्याग्नीषोमीयं पशुम् उपाकरोति
6.32.197.m:
Then, according to the procedure of the sacrificial post, he erects the sacrificial post.
Having let go of the sacrificial post having a chip, he dedicates the animal victim for Agni and Soma.

6.32.197.s: tasya prasiddhaṃ vapayā caritvā vapāśrapaṇī anuprahṛtya samutkramya cātvāle mārjayante |
6.32.197.d: तस्य प्रसिद्धं वपया चरित्वा वपाश्रपणी अनुप्रहृत्य समुत्क्रम्य चात्वाले मार्जयन्ते ।
6.32.197.m: Having performed the standard ritual with its omentum, having thrown the two omentum-spits into [the fire], having stepped forth together, they purify themselves at the cātvāla pit.

6.32.197.s: atha yo vīḍitaḥ kumbhas taṃ yācati
6.32.197.d: अथ यो वीडितः कुम्भस् तं याचति
6.32.197.m: Then he asks for the jar that is strong.

6.32.197.s: tam ādāyāntareṇa cātvālotkarāv udaṅṅ upaniṣkramya yatrāpas tad yanti
6.32.197.d: तम् आदायान्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् उदङ्ङ् उपनिष्क्रम्य यत्रापस् तद् यन्ति
6.32.197.m: Taking it, going out northwards between the cātvāla pit and the rubbish heap, they go to where there is water.

6.32.197.s: nāntam ā vahantīratyeti na sthāvarāṇāṃ gṛhṇāti
6.32.197.d: नान्तम् आ वहन्तीरत्येति न स्थावराणां गृह्णाति
6.32.197.m:
He does not go beyond the end of the flowing [waters];
he does not draw from standing [waters].

6.32.197.s: pratīpaṃ tiṣṭhan gṛhṇāti chāyāyai cātapataś ca saṃdhau gṛhṇāti haviṣmatīr imā āpo haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmām̐ āvivāsati haviṣmām̐ astu sūryas | iti |
6.32.197.d: प्रतीपं तिष्ठन् गृह्णाति छायायै चातपतश् च संधौ गृह्णाति हविष्मतीर् इमा आपो हविष्मान् देवो अध्वरो हविष्माँ आविवासति हविष्माँ अस्तु सूर्यस् । इति ।
6.32.197.m:
Standing facing upstream, he draws [water];
he draws at the junction of shade and sunlight, with: “Rich in oblation are these waters; rich in oblation is the divine sacrificial rite; rich in oblation the one who desires to attend; rich in oblation may the sun be.”

6.32.197.s: athainā ādāya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya savye 'm̐se nidhāyaitenaiva yathetam etyottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ parītyottareṇa sadaḥ parītya pūrvayā dvārā śālāṃ prapādya jaghanena gārhapatyam aupasadāyāṃ vedyām̐ sam̐spṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | agner vo 'pannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi sumnāya sumninīḥ sumne mā dhatta | iti |
6.32.197.d: अथैना आदाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य सव्ये ऽँसे निधायैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्योत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं परीत्योत्तरेण सदः परीत्य पूर्वया द्वारा शालां प्रपाद्य जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् औपसदायां वेद्याँ सँस्पृष्टाः सादयति । अग्नेर् वो ऽपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामि सुम्नाय सुम्निनीः सुम्ने मा धत्त । इति ।
6.32.197.m: Then, taking them, turning around clockwise, placing [the jar] on his left shoulder, coming along this very way as he went, going around north of the āgnīdhra shed, going around north of the sadas, bringing it into the hall through the eastern door, behind the gārhapatya [fire] on the upasad altar, touching [it], he sets them down, with: “In the seat of Agni of fallen house I place you; / bringing favor to favor, place me in favor!”
Then he portions out the animal cake.

The animal cake concludes with the iḍā portion.
The animal sacrifice concludes with the patnīsaṃyāja offerings.

6.33.198.s: atha vasatīvarīḥ parihariṣyann āha vyapakrāmata mā vo 'bhiparihāriṣam iti
6.33.198.d: अथ वसतीवरीः परिहरिष्यन्न् आह व्यपक्रामत मा वो ऽभिपरिहारिषम् इति
6.33.198.m: Then, about to carry around the vasatīvarī waters, he says: “Step away, lest I carry [them] around over you!”
The sacrificer sits down in the sacrificer's place.

6.33.198.s: jaghanena gārhapatyaṃ patnī | athainā ādāya dakṣiṇayā dvāropanirhṛtya savye 'm̐se nidhāya dakṣiṇena sadaḥ parītya dakṣiṇena mārjālīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇato yūpena sam̐spṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | indrāgniyor bhāgadheyī stha | iti |
6.33.198.d: जघनेन गार्हपत्यं पत्नी । अथैना आदाय दक्षिणया द्वारोपनिर्हृत्य सव्ये ऽँसे निधाय दक्षिणेन सदः परीत्य दक्षिणेन मार्जालीयं धिष्णियं पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणतो यूपेन सँस्पृष्टाः सादयति । इन्द्राग्नियोर् भागधेयी स्थ । इति ।
6.33.198.m:
The wife [sits] behind the gārhapatya [fire].
Then taking them, carrying [them] out by the southern door, placing [the jar] on his left shoulder, going around south of the sadas, carrying it around south of the mārjālīya dhiṣṇiya hearth, south of the sacrificial post, touching [it], he sets them down, with: “You two are the share of Indra and Agni.”

6.33.198.s: athainā ādāyodaṅṅ āvṛtya dakṣiṇe 'm̐se nidhāyaitenaiva yathetam etya jaghanena gārhapatyam aupasadāyāṃ vedyām̐ sam̐spṛṣṭāḥ sādayati mitrāvaruṇayor bhāgadheyī stha | iti |
6.33.198.d: अथैना आदायोदङ्ङ् आवृत्य दक्षिणे ऽँसे निधायैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् औपसदायां वेद्याँ सँस्पृष्टाः सादयति मित्रावरुणयोर् भागधेयी स्थ । इति ।
6.33.198.m: Then taking them, turning north, placing [the jar] on his right shoulder, coming along this very way as he went, behind the gārhapatya [fire] on the upasad altar, touching [it], he sets them down, with: “You two are the share of Mitra and Varuṇa.”

6.33.198.s: athainā ādāya pūrvayā dvāropanirhṛtya dakṣiṇa evām̐se nidhāyottareṇa sadaḥ parītyottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ paryāhṛtyottarato yūpena sam̐spṛṣṭāḥ sādayati viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha | iti |
6.33.198.d: अथैना आदाय पूर्वया द्वारोपनिर्हृत्य दक्षिण एवाँसे निधायोत्तरेण सदः परीत्योत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं पर्याहृत्योत्तरतो यूपेन सँस्पृष्टाः सादयति विश्वेषां देवानां भागधेयी स्थ । इति ।
6.33.198.m: Then, taking them, carrying them out by the eastern door, placing them on his right shoulder, going around to the north of the sadas shed, carrying them around to the north of the āgnīdhrīya side-hearth, he sets them down on the north touching the sacrificial post [with the words]: 'You are the share of All the Gods.'

6.33.198.s: athainā ādāya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya savye 'm̐se nidhāyaitenaiva yathetam etya jaghanenāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyam̐ sam̐spṛṣṭāḥ sādayati yajñe jāgṛta | iti ||
6.33.198.d: अथैना आदाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य सव्ये ऽँसे निधायैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य जघनेनाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियँ सँस्पृष्टाः सादयति यज्ञे जागृत । इति ॥
6.33.198.m: Then, taking them, turning around from left to right, placing them on his left shoulder, returning by the same way as he had gone, he sets them down behind the āgnīdhrīya side-hearth touching it, [with the words]: 'Keep watch over the sacrifice!'

6.34.198.s: atha payām̐si viśāsti yā samrāḍdhuk tasyai dadhigharmāya dadhi kuruta yā yajamānasya tasyā āmikṣāyai yā patnyai tasyā āśire payaś ca saktūm̐ś ca kuruta śṛtātaṅkyam ādityagrahāya dadhi kuruta puroḍāśīyāni piṣṭāni kuruta dhānā hāriyojanīḥ kuruta caturo 'mbhṛṇām̐s trīn udacanānayuja ekadhanām̐s tryavamān ekādaśaparamām̐ś catasro raśanāś catasro vapāśrapaṇīr dvayam idhmābarhir audumbarān mahāparidhīn kuruta subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyām āhvayatu | iti
6.34.198.d: अथ पयाँसि विशास्ति या सम्राड्धुक् तस्यै दधिघर्माय दधि कुरुत या यजमानस्य तस्या आमिक्षायै या पत्न्यै तस्या आशिरे पयश् च सक्तूँश् च कुरुत शृतातङ्क्यम् आदित्यग्रहाय दधि कुरुत पुरोडाशीयानि पिष्टानि कुरुत धाना हारियोजनीः कुरुत चतुरो ऽम्भृणाँस् त्रीन् उदचनानयुज एकधनाँस् त्र्यवमान् एकादशपरमाँश् चतस्रो रशनाश् चतस्रो वपाश्रपणीर् द्वयम् इध्माबर्हिर् औदुम्बरान् महापरिधीन् कुरुत सुब्रह्मण्यः सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वयतु । इति
6.34.198.m: Then he assigns the milk [portions]: 'From the one that is milked for the Samrāj, make curd for the dadhigharma. From the sacrificer's [cow], [make curd] for the āmikṣā. From the wife's [cow], [make milk] for the milk admixture. Make milk and groats. Make boiled curdled milk for the Āditya cup. Make flour for the cake offerings. Make roasted grains for the Hāriyojana cup. Prepare four large vessels, three dipping-ladles, an odd number of ekadhana pitchers—at least three and at most eleven—four ropes, four caul-spits, two sets of kindling wood and sacrificial grass, and large enclosing sticks made of udumbara wood. Let the subrahmaṇya priest call out the subrahmaṇyā formula!'

6.34.199.s: yathāsaṃpraiṣaṃ te kurvanti | athaitān ambhṛṇān āyātayati | uttarasya havirdhānasya nīḍa ādhavanīyam |
6.34.199.d: यथासंप्रैषं ते कुर्वन्ति । अथैतान् अम्भृणान् आयातयति । उत्तरस्य हविर्धानस्य नीड आधवनीयम् ।
6.34.199.m: They act according to the direction. Then he arranges these large vessels: the ādhavanīya trough in the seat of the northern havirdhāna cart;
the pūtabhṛt vessel in the fore-part of the cart-frame. There is a common dipping-ladle for both of them.

6.34.199.s: āgnīdhra ekam̐ sodacanam | mārjālīya ekam̐ sodacanam āgnīdhra etām̐ rātriṃ yajamānaḥ saṃviśati
6.34.199.d: आग्नीध्र एकँ सोदचनम् । मार्जालीय एकँ सोदचनम् आग्नीध्र एताँ रात्रिं यजमानः संविशति
6.34.199.m: One [vessel] with a dipping-ladle in the āgnīdhra shed; one with a dipping-ladle at the mārjālīya hearth. The sacrificer lies down for this night in the āgnīdhra shed.
They guard King Soma in the havirdhāna shed.

7.1.200.s: athāto mahārātra eva budhyante saṃbodhayanty etān ṛtvijo 'dhvaryum̐ hotāraṃ brahmāṇam udgātāraṃ pratiprasthātāraṃ prastotāraṃ praśāstāraṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sinam acchāvākaṃ neṣṭāraṃ potāram̐ sadasyam unnetāram āgnīdhraṃ grāvastutam̐ subrahmaṇyaṃ pratihartāraṃ ye cānye parikarmiṇo bhavanti
7.1.200.d: अथातो महारात्र एव बुध्यन्ते संबोधयन्त्य् एतान् ऋत्विजो ऽध्वर्युँ होतारं ब्रह्माणम् उद्गातारं प्रतिप्रस्थातारं प्रस्तोतारं प्रशास्तारं ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिनम् अच्छावाकं नेष्टारं पोतारँ सदस्यम् उन्नेतारम् आग्नीध्रं ग्रावस्तुतँ सुब्रह्मण्यं प्रतिहर्तारं ये चान्ये परिकर्मिणो भवन्ति
7.1.200.m: Now then, while it is still the dead of night, they awake. They awaken these officiating priests: the adhvaryu priest, the hotṛ priest, the brahman, the udgātṛ priest, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, the prastotṛ priest, the praśāstṛ priest, the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the acchāvāka, the neṣṭṛ, the potṛ, the sadasya, the unnetṛ, the āgnīdhra, the grāvastut, the subrahmaṇya, the pratihartṛ, and whoever else are attendants.
Having washed their hands and feet, they assemble near the sacrificer in the āgnīdhra shed.

7.1.200.s: athādhvaryur hastau saṃmṛśate karmaṇe vāṃ devebhyaḥ śakeyam iti | athātraiva tiṣṭhan saṃpraiṣam āha | unnetar grāvṇo vāyavyāni droṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāya dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya puro 'kṣam̐ sam̐sādaya | agnīd ājyam adhiśraya pratiprasthātaḥ srucaḥ saṃmṛḍḍhy ājyenodehi pṛṣadājyāya dadhy āhara | iti
7.1.200.d: अथाध्वर्युर् हस्तौ संमृशते कर्मणे वां देवेभ्यः शकेयम् इति । अथात्रैव तिष्ठन् संप्रैषम् आह । उन्नेतर् ग्राव्णो वायव्यानि द्रोणकलशे दशापवित्रे समवधाय दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पुरो ऽक्षँ सँसादय । अग्नीद् आज्यम् अधिश्रय प्रतिप्रस्थातः स्रुचः संमृड्ढ्य् आज्येनोदेहि पृषदाज्याय दध्य् आहर । इति
7.1.200.m: Then the adhvaryu priest touches his hands together with: 'May I be able to act for the gods!' Then, standing right there, he utters the direction: 'Unnetṛ priest, having placed the pressing-stones, the vāyavya cups, the droṇakalaśa, and the fringed strainers together, set them down in front of the axle of the southern havirdhāna cart! Āgnīdhra priest, place the clarified butter over the fire! Pratiprasthātṛ priest, cleanse the ladles, bring forward the clarified butter, and bring curd for the speckled butter!'

7.1.200.s: yathāsaṃpraiṣaṃ te kurvanti | athādhvaryur āgneyyarcāgnīdhram abhimṛśati | agnir mūrdhā divas | iti
7.1.200.d: यथासंप्रैषं ते कुर्वन्ति । अथाध्वर्युर् आग्नेय्यर्चाग्नीध्रम् अभिमृशति । अग्निर् मूर्धा दिवस् । इति
7.1.200.m: They act according to the direction. Then the adhvaryu priest touches the āgnīdhra fire with a verse addressed to Agni: 'Agni is the head of heaven...'

7.1.200.s: vaiṣṇavyā havirdhānam | viṣṇo tvaṃ no antamas | iti |
7.1.200.d: वैष्णव्या हविर्धानम् । विष्णो त्वं नो अन्तमस् । इति ।
7.1.200.m: The havirdhāna cart with [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu: 'O Viṣṇu, you are closest to us...'

7.1.200.s: āgneyyā srucas | ayam agniḥ sahasriṇas | iti vāyavyayā vāyavyāni vāyo śatam̐ harīṇām iti |
7.1.200.d: आग्नेय्या स्रुचस् । अयम् अग्निः सहस्रिणस् । इति वायव्यया वायव्यानि वायो शतँ हरीणाम् इति ।
7.1.200.m: The ladles with [a verse] addressed to Agni: 'This is the thousandfold Agni...'; the vāyavya cups with [a verse] addressed to Vāyu: 'O Vāyu, a hundred bay horses...'

7.1.200.s: aindryā sadas | indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan | iti |
7.1.200.d: ऐन्द्र्या सदस् । इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् । इति ।
7.1.200.m: The sadas shed with [a verse] addressed to Indra: 'All have magnified Indra...'
Then, having taken the clarified butters along with the speckled butter, he stands up with the sprinkling waters.

7.1.200.s: idhmaṃ prokṣati vediṃ prokṣati barhiḥ prokṣati barhirāsannaṃ prokṣyopaninīya purastāt prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti |
7.1.200.d: इध्मं प्रोक्षति वेदिं प्रोक्षति बर्हिः प्रोक्षति बर्हिरासन्नं प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्तात् प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति ।
7.1.200.m: He sprinkles the kindling wood; he sprinkles the altar; he sprinkles the sacrificial grass; having sprinkled the sacrificial grass that has been placed, and having poured [the rest of the water] down, he takes the grass bundle from the east.

7.1.200.s: ekavidhaṃ barhi stīrtvā prastarapāṇiḥ prāṅ abhisṛpyaudumbarān mahāparidhīn paridadhāti nityena paridhānena |
7.1.200.d: एकविधं बर्हि स्तीर्त्वा प्रस्तरपाणिः प्राङ् अभिसृप्यौदुम्बरान् महापरिधीन् परिदधाति नित्येन परिधानेन ।
7.1.200.m: Having spread the sacrificial grass in a single layer, creeping eastward with the grass bundle in hand, he lays down the large enclosing sticks made of udumbara wood in the prescribed manner of laying enclosing sticks.

7.1.200.s: athainān yogena yunakti yunajmi te pṛthivīṃ jyotiṣā saha | iti madhyamam |
7.1.200.d: अथैनान् योगेन युनक्ति युनज्मि ते पृथिवीं ज्योतिषा सह । इति मध्यमम् ।
7.1.200.m: Then he yokes them with the yoking formula: with 'I yoke the earth for you together with light', the middle one;

7.1.200.s: yunajmi vāyum antarikṣeṇa te saha | iti dakṣiṇam |
7.1.200.d: युनज्मि वायुम् अन्तरिक्षेण ते सह । इति दक्षिणम् ।
7.1.200.m: with 'I yoke Vāyu for you together with the atmosphere', the southern one;

7.1.200.s: mṛśati yunajmi tisro vipṛcaḥ sūryasya te | iti |
7.1.200.d: मृशति युनज्मि तिस्रो विपृचः सूर्यस्य ते । इति ।
7.1.200.m: he touches [the northern one] with: 'I yoke for you the three dispersals of the sun.'
Then, having touched water, he says: 'Come, sacrificer!'

7.1.201.s: pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādyāthaitac carma phalakayoḥ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomopastṛṇāti yajña pratitiṣṭha | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ vā
7.1.201.d: पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपाद्याथैतच् चर्म फलकयोः प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमोपस्तृणाति यज्ञ प्रतितिष्ठ । इति वा तूष्णीं वा
7.1.201.m: Having caused him to enter the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door, he then spreads this skin on the two sounding-boards with the neck to the east and the hairy side up, either with 'O sacrifice, be firmly established!' or silently.

7.1.201.s: tasmin saṃmukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyāntareṇeṣe rājānam upāvaharati hṛde tvā manase tvā soma rājann ehy avaroha | iti dvābhyām
7.1.201.d: तस्मिन् संमुखान् ग्राव्णः कृत्वा दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्यान्तरेणेषे राजानम् उपावहरति हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा सोम राजन्न् एह्य् अवरोह । इति द्वाभ्याम्
7.1.201.m: Having arranged the pressing-stones facing one another upon it, he brings King Soma down between the shafts of the southern havirdhāna cart with the two [formulas]: 'For the heart you!', 'For the mind you!', 'O King Soma, come, descend!'

7.1.201.s: athainam udgātṛbhyaḥ prāhus | tasmim̐s tac ceṣṭanti yat te vidus |
7.1.201.d: अथैनम् उद्गातृभ्यः प्राहुस् । तस्मिँस् तच् चेष्टन्ति यत् ते विदुस् ।
7.1.201.m: Then they announce him to the udgātṛ priests. On it they perform whatever they know.

7.1.201.s: athāpa upaspṛśyāha | ehi yajamāna | iti | āgnīdhraṃ drutvā sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā pañcahotāraṃ manasānudrutyāgnīdhre juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne svāhā | iti |
7.1.201.d: अथाप उपस्पृश्याह । एहि यजमान । इति । आग्नीध्रं द्रुत्वा स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा पञ्चहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्याग्नीध्रे जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने स्वाहा । इति ।
7.1.201.m: Then, having touched water, he says: 'Come, sacrificer!' Running to the āgnīdhra shed and taking four ladlings [of butter] in the offering ladle, he recites the pañcahotṛ formula mentally and, while the sacrificer holds onto him, offers it in the āgnīdhra fire with: 'Svāhā!'

7.1.201.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāgnīdhra evāsanyāṃ juhoti | āsanyān mā mantrāt pāhi kasyāś cid abhiśastyāḥ svāhā | iti |
7.1.201.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाग्नीध्र एवासन्यां जुहोति । आसन्यान् मा मन्त्रात् पाहि कस्याश् चिद् अभिशस्त्याः स्वाहा । इति ।
7.1.201.m: Taking another four ladlings, he offers it right in the āgnīdhra fire into the mouth [of the hearth] with: 'From the formula of the mouth protect me, from anyone's curse, svāhā!'
Then he places a chip [of wood] smeared with clarified butter on the āhavanīya fire silently.
Then, standing right there, he utters the direction:

7.2.201.s: prātaryāvabhyo devebhyo hotar anubrūhi brahman vācaṃ yaccha subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya | agnīt savanīyān nirvapa pratiprasthātaḥ khare pātrāṇi yuṅdhi | iti
7.2.201.d: प्रातर्यावभ्यो देवेभ्यो होतर् अनुब्रूहि ब्रह्मन् वाचं यच्छ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय । अग्नीत् सवनीयान् निर्वप प्रतिप्रस्थातः खरे पात्राणि युङ्धि । इति
7.2.201.m: 'Hotṛ priest, recite for the gods who come in the morning! Brahman, restrain your speech! Subrahmaṇya, call out the subrahmaṇyā formula! Āgnīdhra priest, apportion the savanīya offerings! Pratiprasthātṛ priest, arrange the vessels on the mound!'

7.2.201.s: yathāsaṃpraiṣaṃ te kurvanti pratipadyata eṣa hotā prātaranuvākam |
7.2.201.d: यथासंप्रैषं ते कुर्वन्ति प्रतिपद्यत एष होता प्रातरनुवाकम् ।
7.2.201.m: They act according to the direction. This hotṛ priest begins the morning recitation.

7.2.201.s: yacchati brahmā vācam āhvayati subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyām |
7.2.201.d: यच्छति ब्रह्मा वाचम् आह्वयति सुब्रह्मण्यः सुब्रह्मण्याम् ।
7.2.201.m: The brahman restrains his speech. The subrahmaṇya calls out the subrahmaṇyā formula.

7.2.201.s: tasyām āhutāyāṃ brahmā vācaṃ visṛjate nirvapaty eṣa āgnīdhra aindrān ekādaśakapālān savanīyān |
7.2.201.d: तस्याम् आहुतायां ब्रह्मा वाचं विसृजते निर्वपत्य् एष आग्नीध्र ऐन्द्रान् एकादशकपालान् सवनीयान् ।
7.2.201.m: When that has been invoked, the brahman releases his speech. This āgnīdhra priest apportions the savanīya cakes on eleven potsherds for Indra.
Only over their rice grains does he cause the call for the preparer of the oblation to be sounded.

7.2.201.s: upodyacchante yāvān atha pratiprasthātā khare pātrāṇi yunakti
7.2.201.d: उपोद्यच्छन्ते यावान् अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता खरे पात्राणि युनक्ति
7.2.201.m: They lift up the barley grains. Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest arranges the vessels on the mound.

7.2.202.s: pūrvārdhe kharasya dakṣiṇāśirasam upām̐śusavanaṃ nidadhāti dakṣiṇata upām̐śupātram uttarato 'ntaryāmapātram upasam̐spṛṣṭe
7.2.202.d: पूर्वार्धे खरस्य दक्षिणाशिरसम् उपाँशुसवनं निदधाति दक्षिणत उपाँशुपात्रम् उत्तरतो ऽन्तर्यामपात्रम् उपसँस्पृष्टे
7.2.202.m: In the eastern half of the mound he places the upāṃśusavana stone with its head to the south; to the south the upāṃśu cup, to the north the antaryāma cup, touching each other.
They are not touching each other for one practicing exorcism.
To the west [of them], the vessels for two deities in succession: the aindravāyava cup, the maitrāvaruṇa cup, and the āśvina cup.

7.2.202.s: paścāc chukrāmanthinoḥ prabāhugdakṣiṇam̐ śukrapātram uttaraṃ manthipātram
7.2.202.d: पश्चाच् छुक्रामन्थिनोः प्रबाहुग्दक्षिणँ शुक्रपात्रम् उत्तरं मन्थिपात्रम्
7.2.202.m: To the west, side by side, of the śukra and manthin cups: the śukra cup to the south, the manthin cup to the north.
In front of the manthin cup, the two ṛtu cups; behind, the āgrayaṇa vessel.

7.2.202.s: dakṣiṇasyāṃ kharaśroṇyām ādityasthālīm̐ sopaśayām uttarasyāṃ kharaśroṇyām ukthyasthālīm̐ sopaśayām
7.2.202.d: दक्षिणस्यां खरश्रोण्याम् आदित्यस्थालीँ सोपशयाम् उत्तरस्यां खरश्रोण्याम् उक्थ्यस्थालीँ सोपशयाम्
7.2.202.m: On the southern hip of the mound, the āditya vessel together with its secondary cup; on the northern hip of the mound, the ukthya vessel together with its secondary cup.
In front of the prop of the northern havirdhāna cart, where no earth has been thrown, the dhruva vessel.
Between the pūtabhṛt and ādhavanīya vessels, the goblets.

7.2.202.s: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścādakṣaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ daśāpavitre iti nidadhāti |
7.2.202.d: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चादक्षं द्रोणकलशं दशापवित्रे इति निदधाति ।
7.2.202.m: Behind the axle of the southern havirdhāna cart, he places the droṇakalaśa and the fringed strainers.

7.2.202.s: athaināny abhimṛśati | agnir devatā gāyatrī chandas | upām̐śoḥ pātram asi | iti daśabhir daśa |
7.2.202.d: अथैनान्य् अभिमृशति । अग्निर् देवता गायत्री छन्दस् । उपाँशोः पात्रम् असि । इति दशभिर् दश ।
7.2.202.m: Then he touches them with ten [formulas] for the ten [vessels]: 'Agni is the deity, the gāyatrī is the metre... You are the vessel of the upāṃśu cup...'

7.2.202.s: athādhvaryuḥ saṃ vā viśati karmāṇi vānuprekṣamāṇa āste ||
7.2.202.d: अथाध्वर्युः सं वा विशति कर्माणि वानुप्रेक्षमाण आस्ते ॥
7.2.202.m: Then the adhvaryu priest either goes to rest, or sits watching the ritual actions.

7.3.202.s: atha yatra hotur abhijānāti | abhūd uṣā ruśatpaśus | āgnir adhāyy ṛtviyaḥ | ayoji vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ratho dasrāv amartyas | mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam iti tatpracarṇyām̐ sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye juhoty anvārabdhe yajamāne śṛṇotv agniḥ samidhā havaṃ me śṛṇvantv āpo dhiṣaṇāś ca devīḥ | śṛṇota grāvāṇo viduṣo nu yajñam | śṛṇotu devaḥ savitā havaṃ me svāhā | iti |
7.3.202.d: अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति । अभूद् उषा रुशत्पशुस् । आग्निर् अधाय्य् ऋत्वियः । अयोजि वां वृषण्वसू रथो दस्राव् अमर्त्यस् । माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् इति तत्प्रचर्ण्याँ स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये जुहोत्य् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने शृणोत्व् अग्निः समिधा हवं मे शृण्वन्त्व् आपो धिषणाश् च देवीः । शृणोत ग्रावाणो विदुषो नु यज्ञम् । शृणोतु देवः सविता हवं मे स्वाहा । इति ।
7.3.202.m: Then, when he perceives that the hotṛ priest [is reciting]: 'Dawn has appeared, with bright cattle; Agni has been established at the proper season; your chariot has been yoked, O you of bountiful wealth, wonder-working and immortal; O sweets-loving ones, listen to my call'—at that moment, having taken four ladlings of clarified butter in the offering ladle, he makes an offering into the āhavanīya fire while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, [with the mantra]: 'May Agni hear my call with the kindling wood; may the waters and the divine voices hear; hear now the sacrifice, O wise pressing stones; may the divine Savitar hear my call, svāhā!'

7.3.202.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā barhir ādāya saṃpraiṣam āha | apa iṣya hotar maitrāvaruṇasya camasādhvaryav ādrava | ekadhanina eta neṣṭaḥ patnīm udānaya | agnīd dhotṛcamasena ca mā vasatīvarībhiś ca cātvāle pratyupalambasva | iti
